notes.title: Awesomenauts Premium Relaunch - Update For June 17th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]We have exciting news: we are taking a big step towards reintroducing content and improving the playing experience in Awesomenauts.[/p][p][/p][p]Awesomenauts will be returning to its roots as a premium title. We have pushed the new, premium version to the [b][i]Beta Branch [/i][/b](premium-beta) for community testing and introduced a purchase price of $19.99 for new players on Steam. The testing period is expected to last about a month, after which the premium build will be pushed to the Main Branch.[/p][p][/p][p]We have been able to add all of the content and character skins that were pulled offline back into the game, including the paid Starstorm and Overdrive expansions which are now included in the base game for all players. We are also working on a back-office moderation tool that will allow us to police negative behavior that users report. That tool will be released with the update later this month. Until then, we have disabled in-game chat.[/p][p][/p][p]We encourage you to play the version we have just loaded into the Beta Branch and give us feedback in the [url="https://discord.gg/WStkV3u6TG"]Discord channel[/url].[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Awesomenauts Community Update – Patch Notes For January 17th
notes.content:
Let’s talk about Awesomenauts,

We want to take a moment to address the current state of the game and share some exciting news about our efforts to bring Awesomenauts back to the players. While we haven’t shared much publicly until now, we’ve been working hard behind the scenes ever since Atari acquired the game last October. Our mission at Atari is to preserve and celebrate the games players love, and Awesomenauts is no exception.

When we took over from Ronimo, the game was not in a sustainable state—both operationally and economically. Quite simply the game costs far more to support than it made in revenue because of the way it was engineered and hosted. We've dedicated some time and money into re-engineering the backend services so that the game can be operated cost effectively. We're excited to say that we believe we’re close to a solution.

Although there’s more work to be done, we want to share our current roadmap with you:

[h1]Today: Back to Awesomenauts 3.2.8[/h1]

Starting today, we are moving version 3.2.8 of the game to the main branch on Steam. For those of you familiar with the beta code version, this is now publicly available to everyone without needing steam access codes. While this version is missing the past four years of live ops content, it is the most stable and playable version available to us. Please keep in mind that this is a temporary solution. 

Characters that are no longer available:

[list]
[*] Snork Gunk
[*] Qi'Tara
[*] Commander Rocket
[*] Smiles
[*] Dizzy
[*] Samuel 'Deadlift' Gains
[*] Max Focus
[/list]
Features/functionality that are no longer available:

[list]
[*] Matchmaking improvements since 3.2.8
[*] Rejoin or get locked out of matchmaking after alt-F4 or crash
[*] Custom games browser
[*] Online Replays and live spectating
[*] Parties which persist across matches
[*] Weekly Brawls matchmaking queue
[*] Co-op vs. bots matchmaking queue
[*] Global Chat
[*] Dailies
[*] Online currencies and unlocks (unlockables include characters, drop pods and icons)
[*] Some modding features
[*] Balance adjustments since 3.2.8
[*] Simplified Chinese translation
[/list]
[h1]Looking Ahead: Galactron Version Testing[/h1]

Following the 3.2.8 release, we’ll be launching a Galactron Test Branch. This branch will gradually implement content from the "Galactron" version of the game (the state it was in when the servers were shut down.) We’ll need your help testing this version to ensure it’s stable and playable.

As we work to restore characters and features we will be making updates to the game’s code which may introduce bugs or break some functionality.  We’re relying on the community to be patient with us through this process and encourage you to provide feedback and issue reports. Your input will be crucial in ensuring Awesomenauts returns to its best possible state.

Our goal is to reestablish as much of the original experience as possible.

[h1]Access to DLC Content[/h1]

Once the Galactron version is restored, any DLC that was previously purchased will be available. For example, if you purchased a skin in the past, you will have access to use it again. 

[h1]Thank You for Your Patience[/h1]

We understand that this has been a long road, and we truly appreciate your patience and dedication to Awesomenauts. We’re committed to restoring much of the game to its former glory, and we can’t wait to celebrate its return with all of you.

Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll be counting on your feedback in the months to come!

Thanks for sticking with us,

– The Atari Team

The Awesomenauts Arena League is returning for a 3rd iteration! The tournament will consist of group stage qualifiers taking place on the weekend of [b]November 5th and 6th[/b]. Teams that advance to the playoffs will play in a double elimination format on the weekend of [b]November 12th and 13th[/b].

notes.title: Issues in Nauts since 19th Sept 2022
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we have some unfortunate news. Since Monday 19th September, a host of issues popped up in Nauts and we have very little idea as to what caused them. We have contacted Steam and are also looking into this ourselves. But considering that this seemed to have happened out of the blue, we do not yet know how to approach solving the issues, so do not have an estimate when these issues will be fixed. We will keep you updated if we have any new information. 

Problems experienced:
[list]
[*] Free Nauts rotations differ for different players.
[*] Nauts do not unlock using in-game currency. Error message “Purchase failed: Could not grant Steam DLC!”.
[*] Redeemed Nauts, skins, and other items do not show up in-game for players. 
[*] Purchased Nauts, skins, and other items do not show up in-game for players. 
[*] Prices of Nauts, skins, bundles, and other items show up as “$0,00”, even though they are correctly priced in the Steam store. 
[*] Players are only able to choose the default skin option for each Naut. [/list]
If you have recently purchased Nauts DLC and wish to get a refund, please contact [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/ ]Steam Support[/url] and create a ticket for the item(s) in question. 
One comparatively fortunate factor is that matchmaking is not affected, so players can still play the game with Nauts that have already been unlocked, or are currently on the free rotation. 
We apologise for this inconvenience and will keep you updated once we find out more.

notes.title: All Nauts Unlocked! + Steam Summer Sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/8f1261bfe82b13507d43a40a6a53cbd0ce6b59d8.png[/img]

[h3]For the coming 2 weeks, every Awesomenaut will be made available to play for everyone, even if you don’t own or haven’t unlocked them! [/h3]

Jump in to the game whether you would like to just try out a new Naut, or you’d like to try a new team composition for the upcoming [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/3050606033323038243]Nutty Nauts Tournament[/url], or it’s finally time for you to be the flex god you were always meant to be!

If you like to own a Naut you tried, you can purchase them with in-game currency that you earn through playing games, completing tasks, and levelling up. But you can also purchase them from Steam and this is a great chance to score anything Nauts related, whether it's an announcer, a cool skin, or a new Naut, since almost everything is marked 60% off! If you would like all of the Awesomenauts, why not go for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/Awesomenauts_All_Nauts_pack/]All Nauts Pack[/url], which is also on (a smaller 25%) offer during the Steam Summer Sale. The All Nauts Pack also comes with an exclusive Lonestar skin – Goldstar, that’s only obtainable through owning the All Nauts Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/5b01d8dd9ec4340f530a23903a32ef560546222e.png[/img]

Like a new character but don’t feel like paying for the skins? You can also earn free skins by watching the Ronimo Streamisho on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ronimogames]Twitch Channel[/url]. We’re live every Monday and Thursday at 7pm CET. You get Roni Points by just watching, but you can earn more by engaging with chat and participating stream events! Once you have earned sufficient Roni Points, select a skin of your choice from the active rotation, open the Channel Points shop located underneath the chat box, and select the reward you would like to redeem. Some rewards, like the Medium Rare reward, have multiple options, so be sure to tell us which option you would like when you redeem the reward!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.7 Beta Updated!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d1cb7fbc4cf14139617835fcaf5d5f0dc6160ac0.png[/img]During the Streamisho today, we released an update for the 4.7 Open Beta! This update contains extensive rebalancing to Snork Gunk, as well as some fixes and changes to other characters.

Catch the full patch notes below, and don't forget to check out the Beta if you haven't already! Here's a guide on how to access it: https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487. Discuss the Beta on the forums ([url]https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19[/url]) or join us on the official Ronimo Games Discord over at [url]https://discord.gg/ronimo[/url]

[h1][b]Update 4.7 - Beta 2[/b][/h1]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Fixed that skills could be triggered when getting stunned or silenced by holding down the skill button when the Skill aiming visual option is enabled.[/list]
[b]Turrets[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where players who stuck close to the top of Sentry’s totem while it was close to a turret would distract the turret, but not get hit.[/list]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b]
[list][*]Rocket Launch, minimum damage increased from 150 to 200, maximum damage increased from 350 to 400.[/list]
[b]Ix[/b]
[list][*]Tree Hugger, fixed that the second stage of the upgrade did nothing.[/list]
[b]Nibbs[/b]
[list][*]Demon animal necklace, fixed that the upgrade affects the actual cooldown, and not just in the HUD.
[*]Eternal Flame, fixed that this upgrade created 4 flames instead of the intended 3.
[*]Fire breath, fixed that there were still some occasions where she could be moved during the ability.[/list]
[b]Penny Fox[/b]
[list][*]Energy Pulse, fixed that it now correctly does 90 damage, as stated in the previous patch notes.[/list]
[b]Sentry[/b]
[list][*]Black hole sun, outer/minimum gravity force reduced by 5%.
[*]Ejection seat, fixed that the heal could be triggered when the teleport was still on cooldown due to Sentry taking damage.
[*]Interrogation answering machine, fixed that it gives a 33% attack speed boost as described in the tooltip.
[*]Interrogation answering machine, fixed that it now correctly stacks with Dog tags.
[*]Photon mine launcher, fixed attack speed tooltip.
[*]Photon mine launcher, reduced direct damage from 90 to 85.
[*]Drive-over skulls, now increases explosion range of Photon mines by 60% (as it was in 4.5)[/list]
[b]Smiles[/b]
[list][*]Base health reduced from 1650 to 1600.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, now checks with obstacles before enemies, making Smiles unable to connect the hook though walls and turrets.[/list]
[b]Snork Gunk[/b]
[list][*]Shell bombs, fixed that the tooltip would say the skill spawns 4 shells when Cockle multiball was bought.
[*]Shell bombs, explosion damage reduced from 200 to 160.
[*]Shell bombs, now breaks stealth upon activation and makes Snork unable to go into stealth until the skill is over.
[*]Disco clamball, now attaches a single-use heal to every shell bomb which heals allied Awesomenauts upon contact for 50 per stage.
[*]Sticky snail, no longer does damage at base.
[*]Sticky snail, increased the snail forward speed by 100%.
[*]Sticky snail, decreased the retraction speed by 20%, both speeds are now equal.
[*]Sticky snail, Snork is no longer damage immune during the ability.
[*]Sticky snail, range increased by 20%.
[*]Conchball broom, range increase reduced from 50% to 25%.
[*]Nasty sweat band, now adds 100 damage per stage to the impact of sticky snail.
[*]Tear gas, now leaves a gas cloud when using conch dunk every 5 seconds. The gas deals 45 damage per second and hangs around for 3 seconds.
[*]Action gloves, now adds 50% base damage to the next conch dunk when hitting an enemy Awesomenaut with a shell bomb or sticky snail.
[*]Snail slime container, shield now disappears when all shells have hit.
[*]Snail slime container, price increased from 165 to 210.[/list]
[b]Yuri[/b]
[list][*]Base health reduced from 1400 to 1350.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d9fd955a7a5293eaf0a400777230c05ff0e821a8.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time has launched on Steam, including a wide array of balance tweaks and gameplay improvements! A big thanks to everyone who participated in the open beta for this update and shared their thoughts on some of the planned changes.

Please share your thoughts on the update below or on [url=https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=6]our official forums[/url]. We're already working on a hotfix to address some unintended changes and bugs that crept into the release, so please stay tuned on that! This hotfix is slated to release on Friday 20th April, and we'll have patch notes on that when we get closer to its release.

The full patch notes for Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time are included below.

[H1]Update 4.6: Tinker Time[/H1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cf19c3b5917941055204147d2b4745161cdff74c.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b]
[i]Currently too safe and very hard to catch, Rocket needs to be easier to punish[/i][list]
[*]Rocket Launch, no longer knocks back enemies.
[*]Base Health, reduced from 1150 to 1100[/list]
[i]Laser Trap is too unreliable, doing either too much damage or none at all. These changes should make its effect more reliable while also making placement a little bit more skillful.[/i][list]
[*]Laser Trap, time between damage ticks increased from 0.2 to 0.3.
[*]Laser Trap, damage per tick increased from 60 to 90.
[*]Laser Trap, rotation speed increased by 50%.
[*]Laser Trap, laser length reduced by 10%.
[*]Laser Trap, no longer has deployment time.
[*]Laser Trap, duration reduced from 4 to 3 seconds. [/list]
[i]Some upgrade adjustments based on the above changes. These are intended to keep Rocket brawling closer to his Laser Trap.[/i][list]
[*]Profanity filters, now increases trap duration by 2 seconds for 160 solar.
[*]Borgo Cigar cutter, CMDR Rocket gets a shield which reduces 30% of the incoming damage as long as he is nearby a deployed laser trap. [/list]
[i]This upgrade is still too strong and mandatory[/i]
[*]Box of Cirean cigars, damage per particle per stage reduced from 20 to 16. [/list]
[i]His Rocket Launch no longer deals damage to turrets, but his turret push is still too intense. Adjusting the numbers and making them more consistent.[/i] [list]
[*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against droids increased from 75% to 80%
[*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against turrets reduced from 100% to 80%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade was a holdover from a time where Rocket’s Laser Trap had a lot more uptime. The intention for this replacement is to enable Rocket to be a bit better at brawling and allowing him to stay a bit closer to the fight[/i] [list]
[*]Head in Jar, now adds 16% damage to Charged Salvo when firing a single rocket, two stages for 175 solar each. [/list]
[i]Part of his safety comes from his relatively high ranged base attack.[/i] [list]
[*]Charged Salvo, range reduced by 20%.
[*]Medal Booster Pack, range increase reduced from 25% to 20%.[/list]
[i]Combining Rocket Launch and a full Charged Salvo at melee range provides too much damage, too easily. At the same time we want to stimulate him to get more into the thick of the fight.[/i] [list]
[*]Rocket Launch, now deals between 150 and 350 damage, depending on how long the rocket has been flying.
[*]Mother of Bombs, after using Rocket Launch without hitting an enemy, your next Charged Salvo shot will deal 100 more damage for 170 solar. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/823d399cc943558129d3bb1f405c248306662d21.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]We consider Derpl a bit too strongly affected by map choice and enemy team choices. Our intention is to weaken him a bit on the maps where he does too well, while also strengthening him against his counters.[/i] [list]
[*]Siege mode, Derpl is no longer immune to CC during the transformation out of siege mode.
[*]Siege mode, Derpl's CC immunity now also works against timeslow effects and cocoons.
[*]Combustion lava lamp, size increase reduced from 22% to 18%.
[*]Falling acceleration reduced by 20%.[/list]
[i]Traps can be very oppressive, maxing out at full 2.4 seconds of no gameplay for the receiving party. Their long lifetime also stimulates camping gameplay.[/i] [list]
[*]Trap, snare duration reduced from 1.6 to 1.2 seconds
[*]Trap, now also slows for 30% for 2.4 seconds. (extenting 1.2 seconds beyond the snare)
[*]Trap, base lifetime reduced from 11 to 9 seconds.
[*]Empowered Grid, snare increase per stage reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.
[*]Lead casing, the silence now has a fixed duration of 2 seconds.
[*]Trap, now charges in the middle of Derpl instead of having an arming time when placed.
[*]Trap, deployment time reduced from 0.6 to 0.4 seconds. [/list]
[i]Some base attack adjustments to better balance the row and take the above changes into account.[/i] [list]
[*]Fat Cat, cooldown increased from 4 to 5 seconds, price increased from 185 to 195.
[*]Kitty Catsuit, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]CAT package, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]Bat Catsuit, now deals 100% increased damage against Nauts who are snared or slowed, no longer works with Fat Cat.
[*]Long Cat, now works with Fat Cat. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/306d6f4cd9cfb2e4744d49e424863f0562d72426.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Dizzy is currently a bit too strong. But she's also very finicky, and has a lot of weak upgrades.[/i] [list]
[*]Multi Dash, time between dashes increased from 0.3 to 0.4 seconds.
[*]Multi Dash, damage per dash increased from 150 to 160.
[*]Walkbot Pro, speed up dash reload time by 30% when you are near to enemies.
[*]Explosive Clone, cooldown increased from 6 to 7 seconds.
[*]Backstage pass, increase the range of your Multi Dash by 50% when you have the maximum amount of dashes charged.
[*]Matching Glittery Dungarees, now reduces the cooldown for the next Explosive Clone by 3 seconds when it hits an enemy Awesomenaut.
[*]"Purple Prince" lipstick, now also slows enemies when they leave the bubble as well as when they are hit by the explosion.
[*]Bubble shot, size increased by 50%.
[*]Graffiti artist, price increased from 165 to 190.
[*]Tipi teal, merged to one stage of 30% range and speed increase for 140 solar.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/89e6d6a97346b9e10bb82ea3b76823a8a1089bdc.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Ix generally still brings too much to the table overall, great displace move, solid heals, invincibility frames, excellent mobility and strong brawling. In order to nudge him more towards his role his brawling should be reduced.[/i] [list]
[*]Refract, cooldown increased from 9 to 10.
[*]Radiate, damage per Scatter reduced from 15 to 12.
[*]Mammoth hair scarf, ally speed bonus increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Tree hugger, ally damage boost increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Personality Crystal, range increase reduced from 35% to 30%.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/92056c0875f58423dbc8774bae1acad1ef54924d.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b]
[list][*]Ribbit snail slime, fixed that the healthpack would time out if it fell for too long. [/list]
[i]Since these aren’t that much better than regular boots, they also don’t have to cost much more.[/i] [list]
[*]Rocket boots, solar price reduced from 160 to 140.
[*]Base speed, increased by 4%.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/32af7797f04668c4503d32c67c12e724841d75e0.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b]
[i]This item has its use, but it's too weak and expensive.[/i] [list]
[*]From pond to podium, merged into one stage which adds 30% range and speed for 200 solar. [/list]
[i]The homing upgrade looks cool, but doesn't do much. Here is a replacement proposal.[/i] [list]
[*]UFO spotted, now gives +50% speed during Scene Illumination for 160 solar. [/list]
[i]This upgrade is just a bit too expensive, especially given the next change.[/i] [list]
[*]Sadak mysteries, price reduced from 195 to 175 solar. [/list]
[i]Removing the stacking will reduce the need to combo with Sadak.[/i] [list]
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken, damage increased from 120 to 135 per stage, no longer stacks with Sadak mysteries. [/list]
[i]This item is just a bit too expensive.[/i]
[*]Rob Bourgogne, price reduced from 180 to 160 per stage. [/list]
[i]This item was overnerfed shortly after launch, because the skill was too strong to begin with at the time.[/i] [list]
[*]Hairy King, size increase increased from 10% to 15%, price increased from 175 to 200 solar. [/list]
[i]Some overpriced items.[/i] [list]
[*]Don Steward, price per stage reduced from 175 to 140 solar.
[*]Pete Jennirks, price reduced from 240 to 200 solar.
[*]Incriminating dirt, price reduced from 180 to 150 solar.
[*]Flying camera, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar. [/list]
[i]Meanwhile, this one's underpriced.[/i] [list]
[*]Hidden microphone, price increased from 170 to 200 solar. [/list]
[i]This item is the strongest on the row, it doesn't need to stack further.[/i] [list]
[*]Galactic police scanner, no longer stacks with incriminating dirt, price increased from 180 to 220 solar. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/ed41d63c6b924f52411cec848bbdf99405c2cae4.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b]
[list] [*]Firebreath, fixed that after being Cocooned by Genji during Firebreath she wouldn't resume after the Cocoon wears off. [/list]
[i]Some price adjustments.[/i] [list]
[*]Skull dunduns, price reduced from 200 to 180.
[*]Eye of Coba, price reduced from from 215 to 190.
[*]Dragon Speaker Idol, now has two stages of +10% attack speed each, at 125 solar per stage. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6531b00b86ae6b0bdbc084cc9daad93c01a40cfd.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Yoolip[/b]
[i]Some adjustments to improve the item balance for the gaze row.[/i] [list]
[*]Beard Trimming Fork, price reduced from 165 to 130 solar.
[*]Syrup Pouring Robot, maximum lifesteal increased from 120 to 150 per stage. [/list]
[i]Some changes to make Dinos more reliable at base.[/i] [list]
[*]Summon Robo Dinos, now jump at enemies at base.
[*]Summon Robo Dinos, damage per bite reduced from 80 to 75. [/list]
[i]Now this upgrade has become useless.[/i] [list]
[*]Holo Pet Food, now reduces the damage dealt by Nauts who have been bitten by 15% for 1.5 seconds. [/list]

[b]Qi'Tara[/b]
[list][*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that she couldn’t use Chakram Shift to teleport while using Seven Star Strike when the Salty Seal upgrade was bought.
[*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that the Lily of the Isle projectiles would spawn at her feet during Seven Star Strike. [/list]
[i]Qi’Tara deals too much damage during Seven Star Strike, and too little outside of it.[/i] [list]
[*]Seven star strike, attack speed increase reduced from 40% to 30%.
[*]Poisonous blade, direct damage increased from 45 to 50. [/list]
[i]Her relationship with speed feels disjointed, where attacking slows her down but Seven Star Strike speed her up etc. These changes also tie in with the issue above.[/i] [list]
[*]Poisonous Blade, removed movement penalty when attacking.
[*]Seven Star Strike, removed speed bonus during the ability. [/list]
[i]With the changes above, this upgrade has now become useless. This change will make Qi’Tara’s damage output more reliable.[/i] [list]
[*]Chilasi Chakram, now speeds up the damage over time of Poisonous blade by 20% for 160 solar. [/list]
[i]Since the bug was fixed where this upgrade doubled your damage, this upgrade has become too weak[/i] [list]
[*]Lily of the Isle, projectile speed and range increased by 30%.[/list]
[i]Salty Seal makes Qi’Tara almost unstoppable, this change should make counterplay possible again[/i] [list]
[*]Salty Seal, now activates a shield that blocks 100 damage and provides immunity against slows, stuns, snares, chains, gravity and time warps as long as it’s active. [/list]
[i]Other tweaks and adjustments.[/i] [list]
[*]Seven star strike, now also gives a 10% lifesteal effect.
[*]Baby plumbin oil, additional lifesteal reduced from 30% to 15% for 175 solar.
[*]Rakki Comb, merged to one stage which adds 200% damage vs. droids for 155 solar. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/c3e6b9ea5315191e6b97f4d8f5951b5c8162cf62.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b]
[list] [*]Iron Rifle, fixed that the shield didn’t last long enough to protect the entire charge duration. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7a582ca443e88ea8625584a74d664a6f6567dd19.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b]
[list] [*]Birdseed donuts, cooldown reduction when hit increased from 2 to 4 seconds, duration increase increased from 1 to 2 seconds. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/01394ae6ab660d8f2b8eecb87756a5579245d737.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]His base attack is a bit too weak in general[/i] [list]
[*]Sword Strike, Slash damage increased from 100 to 105, Cleave lifesteal increased from 20% to 30%.
[*]Banner of the Triple Scoop, price per stage reduced from 130 to 100.
[*]Halberd of Justice, bonus damage reduced from 25% to 22%.
[*]Titanium Coneshield, price increased from 130 to 150 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Other tweaks and adjustments[/i] [list]
[*]Brutally Whipped Cream, price reduced from 200 to 180 per stage. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/713fb830953afd54abcf5557ac9a64e88e95c9a4.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b]
[list] [*]Fixed that Sentry’s Beacon no longer emitted a phone interference sound.
[*]Fixed that Starstorm statue didn't affect Bug detector. [/list]
[i]Reducing his efficiency of laying down mines in choke-points which has little to no counter-play.[/i] [list]
[*]Mines, damage while stationary reduced from 80 to 70. [/list]
[i]With this change in mind, a counter-buff to help him land reliable damage output in close ranged scenarios.[/i] [list]
[*]Mines, damage on direct hit increased from 80 to 90.
[*]Projectile speed of mines increased by 15%.[/list]
[i]Camouflage tent is currently emphasizing passive play. This change will reward aggressive use of his AA by increasing his chase potency and reliability.[/i] [list]
[*] Camouflage tent, now increases projectile speed and range by 18%, one stage for 175 solar. [/list]
[i]Drive-over skulls is also providing a lot of easy chip damage and can be replaced with a more active timing based auto-attack.[/i] [list]
[*]Drive-over skulls, now deals +75% direct damage when not firing for 1.5s. [/list]
[i]Currently Black Hole Sun feels inconsistent and very hard to avoid, and if avoided it lingers for a whole 1.5s. This is an attempt at making BHS a more reliable ability and feel more fair on both ends. Starting with rewarding precision and aim on Sentry's end while allowing enemies to dodge the skill easier.[/i] [list]
[*]Black Hole Sun, projectile distance increased by 10%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, projectile speed increased by 10%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, size of black hole reduced by 18%.[/list]
[i]The next set of changes are both aimed at compensating for the size reduction but also to reduce the duration of BHS.[/i] [list]
[*]Black Hole Sun, minimum gravity increased by 8%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, maximum gravity increased by 5%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, duration of black hole reduced from 1.5s to 1.2s. [/list]
[i]With these changes aside, his shield charging up also adds up a lot of time where he's difficult to punish. Reducing his shield duration both allows him for using his black hole quicker, while also being vulnerable faster.[/i] [list]
[*]Shield duration reduced from 2s to 1.5s. [/list]
[i]With less up-time of his shields, his base shield scaling could be increased to fulfill his tanky role. This allows him to tank a little extra in fights and reward aggressive play.[/i] [list]
[*]Black Hole Sun, Base shield increased from 20% to 25%.
[*]Microfilm, shielding reduced from 10% to 8%, price reduced to 140 solar per stage. [/list]
[i]Some Sentry's just leave their beacon sitting somewhere in order to reveal or permanently put pressure on an area.[/i] [list]
[*]Teleport Beacon, times out after 45 seconds. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/533ccae8a301b7a6bcef4fbf5a4f4d898dd7768d.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b]
[list] [*]Made separate spawnpoints for Sawblade and Spare blade, and moved them apart a little.
[*]Sawblade, now deals direct damage instead of damage over time. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/033fc68a9b5c59a6506c8ae4255a147a60ccc750.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b]
[i]Smiles has been overnerfed in the last few updates.[/i] [list]
[*]Base health, increased from 1550 to 1650.
[*]Trapper’s hook, cooldown reduced from 10 to 8 seconds.
[*]Bush fire, range increased by 25%.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/36aa2148c877b5ffaaec29de1e2eb29778af0b34.jpg[/img]
[b]Swiggins[/b]
[list] [*]Poolboy, price reduced from 240 to 210 solar. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/04d99daf1b3c440ab3cc1dcc537d922ea50d6a19.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b]
[list] [*]Chrono Rift, cooldown reduction per stage reduced from 2.5 to 2 seconds.
[*] Uranium spikes, price increased from 125 to 150 per stage.[/list]

notes.title: Tentative Balance Changes for Update 4.6
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/325ac1bb03e68eb4dc93b64b163a9e77620082a1.png[/img]Hey everyone, as we continue to take community input for the upcoming balance & bug fixing update, our designer Jasper has published a document containing tentative balance changes we're planning to introduce in the upcoming Beta. The document is open to comments, and we'd love to get a little more input on these intended changes before we fully implement them.

You can find the document here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ntn7YLoROFB11CTb2tBgI9efuWgvaE2p7ZSmC9vKaZQ/

Please use the comment feature in Google Docs to share your thoughts and provide additional input to the suggestions of other players, but keep it civilized!

Some of the more exciting changes currently lined up include the transformation of Professor M. Yoolip's Wrench Smack to a ranged Wrench Fling attack, multiple tweaks to upgrades for Qi'Tara and Commander Rocket, and changes to the way Turret Mode and Trap placement work for Derpl.

Furthermore, you can share thoughts on some proposed changes to different upgrades in a different sheet, over here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1x_v6Ba9DR--XlP4kXZXEyaFdx-T74vJjiHxWOAczwao/. These changes are currently under consideration but have not yet made it into the list for 'planned' changes, so share your input there as well!

Yoolip's Wrench Smack to a ranged Wrench Fling attack, multiple tweaks to upgrades for Qi'Tara and Commander Rocket, and changes to the way Turret Mode and Trap placement work for Derpl.

18-12-2017

notes.title: Hotfix 4.5.1 now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/489d32791ab1f763de64be2c42b3210cbbd6ab70.png[/img]We just released Awesomenauts 4.5.1 with fixes for some Qi'Tara issues that have been reported since she released on Wednesday, as well as some fixes for problems related to the new bundles. Full patch notes are included below.

While this update fixes a significant number of issues that have been reported so far, we have additional improvements currently in development and will be releasing them in an additional update next week.

Please continue to report issues you encounter [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=13]on our forums[/url], so that we can investigate and address them as soon as possible.

That said, have a great weekend, and enjoy the latest update and Randomnauts Brawl!

[h1]Hotfix 4.5.1[/h1]
[b]General[/b][list][*]Added a profile portrait for the Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara skin, and made it available to players that own the skin.[/list]

[b]Interface[/b][list][*]The skin bundle button in the armory now correctly links to the appropriate skin bundle Steam store page.
[*]Added a skin bundle button to Chucho Krok’s Armory page.
[*]Fixed that the button tooltip for bundle buttons listed the incorrect announcer in some languages.
[*]Fixed that the Starter Pack price did not show correctly in the Armory, and in the Starter Pack popup that displays when you unlock a Starter Pack naut.
[*]Removed unintended display of the Ksenia skin bundle button in the Announcer Armory.
[*]Fixed that some menu tiles had unintentional scrolling functionality.
[*]Fixed that some announcer names would not fit inside their button in the Armory Announcer browser.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d015210e3aa4a17bd76d321a299a1accba7415a6.jpg[/img]
[b]Qi’Tara[/b][list][*]Chakram shift, fixed an issue where the icon for the skill disappeared and the skill became unusable until Qi’Tara died.
[*]Chakram shift, fixed that when an enemy Naut would die while carrying a chakram Qi’Tara would still see the arrow as she could shift to that position.
[*]Lily of the Isle, fixed that if you activated Lily’s effect by hitting an enemy Naut with a Chakram, and then activated Seven star strike, you’d get both a melee and ranged attack. This effectively allowed you to double your damage output.
[*]Lily of the Isle, fixed an issue where Qi'Tara wouldn't show an attack animation during Seven star strike once the Lily of the Ilse upgrade effect wore off.
[*]Seven Star Strike, fixed an issue where Qi’Tara would die instantly from chain effects like Swiggin’s Anchor Drop or Smiles Trapper’s Hook while Seven Star Strike was active and after buying the Salty Seal upgrade.
[*]Qi’Tara’s standard melee attack now prefers nauts and droids over turrets. Because Qi’Tara’s melee attack is single target this should help her clear enemies inside a turret while pushing.[/list]

[b]Known issue[/b]: holding down the Charkram button when the skill comes off cooldown may cause elements of the ability to desync. Waiting for the cooldown to fully reset if this occurs will resolve this issue. This will be addressed in a future update.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f0b18d74dc6fd311d9352c0acf2313e407ceaec4.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Grey man group badge, fixed that the full bar sound would play on every hit once the bar was filled.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bd4aa0fb5482f41b266ce97739083f0c1712c80f.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b][list][*]Weapon switch, fixed an issue where if skill aiming graphics were enabled, stimpack was active, the airstrike button was held, and Ted switches from machine gun to shotgun that the switching time was doubled.[/list]

[*]Removed unintended display of the Ksenia skin bundle button in the Announcer Armory.
[*]Fixed that some menu tiles had unintentional scrolling functionality.
[*]Fixed that some announcer names would not fit inside their button in the Armory Announcer browser.
[*]Chakram shift, fixed an issue where the icon for the skill disappeared and the skill became unusable until Qi’Tara died.
[*]Chakram shift, fixed that when an enemy Naut would die while carrying a chakram Qi’Tara would still see the arrow as she could shift to that position.

[*]Lily of the Isle, fixed that if you activated Lily’s effect by hitting an enemy Naut with a Chakram, and then activated Seven star strike, you’d get both a melee and ranged attack. This effectively allowed you to double your damage output.
[*]Lily of the Isle, fixed an issue where Qi'Tara wouldn't show an attack animation during Seven star strike once the Lily of the Ilse upgrade effect wore off.

[*]Seven Star Strike, fixed an issue where Qi’Tara would die instantly from chain effects like Swiggin’s Anchor Drop or Smiles Trapper’s Hook while Seven Star Strike was active and after buying the Salty Seal upgrade.

tags.balance_change: [*]Qi’Tara’s standard melee attack now prefers nauts and droids over turrets. Because Qi’Tara’s melee attack is single target this should help her clear enemies inside a turret while pushing.

tags.bug: [*]Grey man group badge, fixed that the full bar sound would play on every hit once the bar was filled.

[*]Weapon switch, fixed an issue where if skill aiming graphics were enabled, stimpack was active, the airstrike button was held, and Ted switches from machine gun to shotgun that the switching time was doubled.

notes.title: Revenge of the Renegades NOW LIVE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/489d32791ab1f763de64be2c42b3210cbbd6ab70.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades is now available on Steam, and that means Qi'Tara is now available! The update also adds five new profile portraits to the mix, a number of additional features and tools for the in-game level editor, and much more.

Qi'Tara, the thirty-third playable Awesomenaut, is a cloaked assassin that applies a stacking poison effect to her enemies every time she hits them. Her individual hits don’t deal too much damage, but the poison effect can quickly overwhelm her opponents because of her high attack speed.

Owners of the Awesomenauts All Nauts Pack should have Qi'Tara unlocked right away, while everyone else can unlock her with 10.000 Awesomepoints, or by purchasing her from the Steam store. http://store.steampowered.com/app/561561
Alongside Qi'Tara, we're releasing an awesome premium skin called Dark Masquerade Qi'Tara as well as a brand-new announcer called Renegade Command. http://store.steampowered.com/app/634014 http://store.steampowered.com/app/399835 Furthermore, we're introducing a new Starter Pack in this update. The Starter Pack contains eight accessible characters that highlight various roles and playstyles, and is sure to contain a great line-up for players looking dive deeper into everything Awesomenauts has to offer.

For full patch notes, check the bottom of this post.

Already own some of the 'Nauts contained in the Starter Pack? Don't worry, as the game will automatically refund you the Awesomepoint-value of any duplicate characters you already possess prior to pruchasing the pack. The pack is available at $7.99 and to celebrate the release of Update 4.5 it's temporarily discounted by 20%.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/425541 Last but not least, we're introducing a number of new 'Complete-the-set' bundles on Steam to allow players to obtain all available content for their favorite characters at a 20% discount. Check out the in-game armory for more information.

[h1][b]Update 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades[/b][/h1]
[i]15-11-2017[/i]

[b]NEW character: Qi’Tara[/b]
[i]Being a Chilasi princess, it surprised everyone when Qi’Tara joined the Scargi military. After all, the Chilasi of Gromdom and the snail-like Scargi had been at war for decades in an attempt to settle an ancient dispute: whether the Splumbs that grow in the many gardens on their planet are a fruit, or whether they’re in fact a vegetable, as the Scargi maintained. Despite all that, she quickly rose through the ranks to become a royal guard in the Order of the Scargi Emperor and attained the title of Femme Fatale Haricot Beurre. Some say she seduced the Scargi emperor to provoke her father, the king, while others say she just did it to access the Scargi Shplumb reserves.[/i]

Abilities:
[list][*]Poisonous Blades: Slash and inflict a stacking poison onto your enemies.
[*]Seven Star Strike: Temporarily gain the ability to slash rapidly around you.
[*]Chakram Shift: Throw out a Chakram that sticks to your enemies and warp to it with a second press.[/list]
[b]NEW skin: Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara [/b]
[i]Serving as a member of the Order of the Scargi Emperor, Qi'Tara sometimes has to go undercover and blend into the crowd to protect Emperor Piere Feu Darret. Being a Chilasi (and armed to the teeth), that's rarely an easy feat. As a result, these tasks are usually left to other members of her Order when opportunities alow.

Once a year though, during the national Splumb Carnival, Qi'Tara mingles with the splumb-covered, masked partygoers - marvelling many with what they think is an elaborate Chilasi-costume. The only ones that find out she's not just PRETENDING to be a heavily armed Chilasi warrior are the would-be assassins she encounters.

For Qi'Tara the Splumb Carnival is the best day of the year as it allows her to indulge into her two favorite things: splumbs and murder.[/i]

The Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara skin comes equipped with a fully customized voice set, and owning the skin will unlock a special portrait for use in-game.

[b]NEW: Renegade Command Announcer[/b]
[i]You've got the plan.
You've got the weapons.
You've got the explosives.
You might even have an inside man to get you through the front door and into the facility.
But none of that makes you a Renegade.
For that, you need style. And a narrator.
Let the Renegade Command announcer turn every mission you go on into something special.[/i]

[b]NEW: Awesomenauts Starter pack[/b]
To help new players get started with Awesomenauts, we’re introducing a brand new Starter Pack. This bundle contains eight accessible characters that highlight various roles and playstyles, and is sure to contain a great line-up for players looking dive deeper into everything Awesomenauts has to offer.

Already own one or more of the characters included in this pack? Don't worry! We'll give you the in-game Awesomepoint value for any of the characters you already own, giving you a jumpstart to unlocking other Awesomenauts. 

[b]NEW: Character Bundles[/b]
To help players obtain skins and relevant announcers for their favorite characters, we’re now offering Complete-the-set bundles on Steam that allow players to obtain content at a discount. Check out the armory to learn more about the bundles we have available!

[b]Profile Portraits[/b][list][*]Step right up!
[*]Look at that!
[*]Dobl Dicey
[*]Time-lost Slipper
[*]Rocket toaster[/list]
[b]NEW: Animation editor[/b]
[i]Added the animation editor to the modding tools![/i][list][*]While modding a map you can now open the animation editor with F3.
[*]Just like normal animations, modded animations can be used in maps and can be triggered by AI.
[*]The animation editor features a timeline, parenting and keyframes to create more complex animations. -Through the animation editor you can also put sounds, text and rumble in your levels.
[*]At the moment you can’t add custom sounds so you need to use the sounds that are already in the game.
[*]At the moment you can only add newlines and special characters to Text objects by pasting them from Notepad, since the text field won’t accept them directly.
[*]Due to memory constraints voices are only played if the character/skin/announcer is actually in the match, so for example you can’t use Lonestar’s voice in a mod if there’s no Lonestar in the match. This only goes for voices: sound effects can always be played.[/list]
[b]Behaviour editor[/b][list][*]When reloading ai’s it will also respawn the selected character. This makes testing of behaviour changes easier.
[*]New behaviour option: isTargetInRangeOfSKill. This will check if the behaviour target is in range of a specific skill.
[*]A number of game variables are now directly available inside the behaviour editor. The list is mentioned in the help popup of the behaviour editor. The current variables are: character.width, character.height, character.maxHealth, character.position.x, character.position.y
[*]Area search blocks have two extra parameters to align the search area against the character. These settings are: ‘horizontal alignment to character’ and ‘vertical alignment to character’.[/list]
[b]General[/b][list][*]Skill aiming visuals are now correct when aiming behind you.
[*]Added a team-switch area to the Test Map.
[*]Commander Rocket is now available at 7500 Awesomepoints.[/list]
[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Further lowered the platform in the hiding area in front of the turret in order to make jumping onto more consistently possible.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cf19c3b5917941055204147d2b4745161cdff74c.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b][list][*]Rocket Launch, fixed that the ability could be used to move while snared.
[*]Mother of Bombs, fixed that the nuke bug reduction to the long-distance rocket was still 33% instead of 30%.
[*]Nuke Bug, fixed that it wouldn't activate until 0.2 seconds after Rocket was alive.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/306d6f4cd9cfb2e4744d49e424863f0562d72426.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b][list][*]Fake band aid, fixed that it sometimes didn't give a dash.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/410e49992940edbf5c077577e1a4d2c94c0fbd1e.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b][list][*]Fixed that there was one item missing to his recommended build.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/89e6d6a97346b9e10bb82ea3b76823a8a1089bdc.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b][list][*]Displace, fixed that displacing a bot before the doors open would lock the bot in place for the rest of the match.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/ed41d63c6b924f52411cec848bbdf99405c2cae4.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list][*]Firebreath, fixed that after being cocooned by Genji during firebreath she wouldn't resume after the cocoon wore off.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/32af7797f04668c4503d32c67c12e724841d75e0.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b][list][*]Brutalities of the Kraken Unveiled!, fixed that the bullet would still come out even when Max is stunned during Scene Illumination.
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken Unveiled!, fixed that the bullet would always face the direction at which the Scene Illumination was started.
[*]Walm Krunkbite, fixed that the upgrade didn’t do anything.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f0b18d74dc6fd311d9352c0acf2313e407ceaec4.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Fixed an issue where the charge meter didn’t display the correct values.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bd4aa0fb5482f41b266ce97739083f0c1712c80f.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b][list][*]Airstrike, fixed that the airstrike wouldn't trigger when holding it down while switching to shotgun.
[*]Airstrike, fixed that airstrike showed visual pre aim even when the option is disabled.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/533ccae8a301b7a6bcef4fbf5a4f4d898dd7768d.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Spare blade, fixed that the spare blade would deal 1 damage after Starstorm Statue was bought.
[*]Steeldrum, fixed that the damage upgrade was applied separate from the base damage, resulting in two separate damage numbers.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/87e59fe0a606469ebf234a9d9112a06d2932ba62.jpg[/img]
[b]Vinnie & Spike[/b][list][*]Dead seahorse head, fixed an issue where it was no longer possible to dash through glass platforms when using this upgrade.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.5 Beta Updated!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6adbb6318e0c185c9a5e186ff89504c97214951e.png[/img]We just released the first Beta update for Awesomenauts 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades! Log into the beta to test out the brand new character, Qi'Tara, and some of the other changes we're working on for Update 4.5. The Beta update is currently only available to Windows and Mac users. A Linux version of the update will be released tomorrow.

To celebrate, we're offering a whole bunch of awesome discounts on Awesomenauts skins, droppods, announcers, characters and, for the first time ever: the All Nauts Pack!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/Awesomenauts_All_Nauts_pack 
Grab the All Nauts Pack at 40% off during the sale while you can, as it will be retired from the store once Awesomenauts 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades releases on Steam. The All Nauts Pack will immediately unlock all playable characters in the game, and you'll also unlock any new 'Nauts immediately as they are released.

At this time, the Update 4.5 is scheduled to release on December 6th, so that means you have two more weeks to get the pack. After that, you'll no longer be able to obtain it. We'll let you know about the definitive release date as we get closer to release.

Just like the other skins, they're 40% for the duration of the Autumn Sale!

[Url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/399837/Awesomenauts__The_Ringmaster_Announcer/]The Ringmaster Announcer[/url], which was added in Update 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee, is also on sale for the first time... at a whopping 50% off! Get it while you can, and play some 'Nauts this weekend with some new skins!

notes.title: Update 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades - Now in OPEN BETA
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/289cef3f4379e5291eb9e60750e25a42c82e4ab1.png[/img]Qi'Tara has been preparing her blades for a little while now, and is now one step closer to joining the Awesomenauts! Try her out in the open beta right now and share your feedback on [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19]the official Awesomenauts forums[/url]!

In Update 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades we'll finally have all the members of Rocket's Renegades reunited as members of the Awesomenauts. Qi'Tara complements the team as an incredibly agile assassin that excels at chasing down her victims.

This update also brings a cool new feature to the Level Editor: the animation editor! This new tools gives players the ability to create elaborate animations, and it's the same tool the developers use for many of the in-game effects.

For a complete list of what's new, please [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=51766]check out the patch notes for this first beta[/url]. For a guide on how to access the open beta, [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487&p=274059#p274059]please visit our official forums[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/619335c0e4c6925b02e1011476747bd3f6adbcb6.png[/img]In addition to bringing a new character and this upgrade for the level editor, Update 4.5 will also bring a couple of changes to the different types of content-bundles we have available right now.

Based on a lot of data and user feedback we will be replacing the All Nauts Pack when Update 4.5 launches! In it's place will be a new Starter Pack that's cheaper and more player-friendly, while also keeping the sense of progression intact.

Of course, players who already own the All Nauts Pack will continue to receive new characters as they release - so this change won't impact existing owners in any way.

Furthermore, we'll also be replacing the Costume Parties with a new type of bundle when the update launches. Since the game has gone free to play, not all players have access to the same characters anymore and having a fixed pack of skins for various characters no longer makes as much sense. In the weeks ahead, we'll detail the new Starter Pack and the new skin bundles. 

We'll let you know at least two weeks in advance before the All Nauts Pack and Costume Party packs actually retired, so stay tuned for more news. If you've been holding out on the All Nauts Pack you'll probably want to pick it up in the coming weeks before it's too late!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/Awesomenauts_All_Nauts_pack/

This update also brings a cool new feature to the Level Editor: the animation editor! This new tools gives players the ability to create elaborate animations, and it's the same tool the developers use for many of the in-game effects.

For a complete list of what's new, please [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=51766]check out the patch notes for this first beta[/url]. For a guide on how to access the open beta, [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487&p=274059#p274059]please visit our official forums[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/619335c0e4c6925b02e1011476747bd3f6adbcb6.png[/img]In addition to bringing a new character and this upgrade for the level editor, Update 4.5 will also bring a couple of changes to the different types of content-bundles we have available right now.

Based on a lot of data and user feedback we will be replacing the All Nauts Pack when Update 4.5 launches! In it's place will be a new Starter Pack that's cheaper and more player-friendly, while also keeping the sense of progression intact.

Of course, players who already own the All Nauts Pack will continue to receive new characters as they release - so this change won't impact existing owners in any way.

Furthermore, we'll also be replacing the Costume Parties with a new type of bundle when the update launches. Since the game has gone free to play, not all players have access to the same characters anymore and having a fixed pack of skins for various characters no longer makes as much sense. In the weeks ahead, we'll detail the new Starter Pack and the new skin bundles. 

We'll let you know at least two weeks in advance before the All Nauts Pack and Costume Party packs actually retired, so stay tuned for more news. If you've been holding out on the All Nauts Pack you'll probably want to pick it up in the coming weeks before it's too late!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/Awesomenauts_All_Nauts_pack/

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Hey everyone, we just released Update 4.4.2, which addresses several of the remaining bugs from our last update and makes improvements to the stability of Brawls. As always, please let us know about issues by reporting them in the Support section of our forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=13

Thanks for helping us iron out the last couple of issues over the last week, and we hope you have a blast with the latest update :)

[h1][b]Update 4.4.2[/b][/h1]
17-10-2017

[b]General[/b][list][*]Fixed that 2 missions would be granted after a day rather than 1
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when quitting the game
[*]Fixed incorrect display of ‘M_PartySlot_DownloadingMods’ when locked out of matchmaking
[*]Unlocked Raelynn for recruits who didn’t unlock her when they were first recruited
[*]Added some UI elements and effects to Daily Mission UI to better clarify that only 1 Daily Mission will appear per day.
[*]Fixed that the brawl timer tooltip that appears when hovering over the Brawl button in the Play menu sometimes showed incorrect brawl ETA.
[*]Fixed that quitting the game sometimes took very long
[*]Fixed that it was possible to play with other nauts than Rocco in the Tip Top Brawl, and prevented the same from happening in similar Brawls.
[*]Fixed that players could make custom changes to Brawls[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Commander_Rocket_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b][list][*]Box of cirean cigars, fixed that the second stage did nothing.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b][list][*]Derpl should no longer fire his Nuke from his feet.
[*]Nuke, fixed an issue where it was possible to desync the charging and firing of the Nuke.
[*]Tweaked Derpl’s visual indicator to show the area in which Derpl’s nuke deals damage.
[*]Deployment Pads, fixed that the knockback pulse sometimes wouldn't trigger.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list][*]Gettin’ Out of Da Hood, no longer applies to allied droids.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, no longer applies to allied droids.
[*]The last pieridae transformae, fixed that it didn’t kill enemy droids when playing as team blue.
[*]The last pieridae transformae, fixed that the gold from the killed droid wouldn’t fly to Genji.
[*]The last pieridae transformae, fixed that a droid would spawn and despawn whenever a floor or ceiling was hit by cocoon.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b][list][*]Overexposed nature photo, fixed that the upgrade would still extend the duration bar shown during bond.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list][*]
[*]Micey the Mech-pilot, fixed that the knockback pulse wouldn't trigger correctly when the skill isn't cancelled.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Max_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b][list][*]-Galactic police scanner, fixed that it didn’t stack correctly with Incriminating dirt and Addresses of the Stars![/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Nibbs_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list][*]Orb of Omicron, fixed that the orb sometimes wouldn't spawn.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Tweaked Penny Fox’s visual indicator to show the area and trajectory in which Pulse deals damage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yoolip_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Yoolip[/b][list][*]Badly washed lab coat, fixed that the cooldown effect was also triggered by hitting turrets.
[*]Laboratory Centrifuge, affected droids now drop healthpacks again.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list][*]Fixed that Soulhuntress’ Raelynn’s trail would show up when invisible.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Circuits of Time, fixed that the upgrade wouldn't create a clone.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Steeldrum, fixed tooltip stat.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Bash with Fistbump upgrade can now deflect projectiles again.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b][list][*]Shotgun, fixed that it was possible to shoot at the same time as activating stimpack. This resulted in a shotgun blast from Ted’s feet.
[*]Angel wing toilet paper, fixed that activating stimpack and teleporting at the same time while in possession of this upgrade would keep your shotgun filled up during the stimpack’s effect.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Vinnie_&_Spike_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Vinnie & Spike[/b][list][*]Tweaked Vinnie & Spike’s visual indicator to show the area in which Spike Dive deals damage.[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b][list][*]Purchasing Dead Seahorse Head causes the skill visualization of Spike Dive to remain fixed in the level until cast again or casting Smoke Screen.
[*]Not all skill visualizations accurately predict the range of an ability when targetting behind you.[/list]

Hotfix 1 for Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee is now available! The patch notes for this update are included below. 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1469721435682506733]Click here to get a quick overview of all that is new in Cirque du Brawlee![/url]

[h1]Update 4.4.1[/h1]
6-10-2017

[b]General[/b]
-Fixed that the ‘Gain 4 naut levels’ mission didn’t track properly
-Fixed droppod tiles playing continuous sound.
-Fixed that it was possible to trigger skills twice in the ‘try’ map.
-Added the proper Ringmaster announcer icon in the in-game pause menu.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Coco_Nebulon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Coco[/b]
-Ball lightning, fixed that Coco couldn't autoattack while aiming.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Commander_Rocket_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b]
-Laser Trap, the trap does now fly through glass platforms from above.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b]
-Tornado, fixed that the skill could be triggered without effect during Splash Dash.
-Bio Fuel Cells, fixed that Twister Tweeters damage wasn’t applied when canceling Tornado.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b]
-The last pieridae transformae, hitting neutral creeps with cocoon now also produces flying droids.
-The last pieridae transformae, resulting flying droids rewards such as Solar now go to Genji.
-Auto attack, removed delay caused by skills.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b]
-Acid spit, fixed that Gnaw couldn't autoattack while aiming.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b]
-Missile Barrage, fixed that the skill fired 3 rockets, instead of 4.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b]
-Suprise party mask, fixed description which implied a second stage.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Max_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b]
-Scene Illumination, fixed that it shows the right cooldown in the tooltip.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yoolip_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Yoolip[/b]
-Gripping Gaze, fixed that Yoolip couldn't autoattack while aiming.
-Remote controlled whisk, fixed that the effect would only briefly show up at the end of Gripping Gaze.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b]
[i]Fixing a holdover bug from the beta.[/i]
-Receding Ponytail, solar cost increased from 220 to 270.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b]
-Circuits of time, fixed that no clone was produced upon teleporting.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b]
-Sawblade, fixed that Skree couldn't autoattack while aiming.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Admiral_Swiggins_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Swiggins[/b]
-Drop Anchor, fixed that turning off the skill aiming visual had no effect.
-Drop Anchor, fixed that the Admiral couldn't autoattack while aiming.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b]
-Added a visual indicator for airstrike showing the width of the airstrike ability.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Voltar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Voltar[/b]
-Increased jump height by 2.5% to make Voltar more reliably reach the platforms in front of the lower turrets in Aiguillon.
