notes.title: Patch notes for Update 4.4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee is now available! The patch notes for this update are included below, but [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1469721435682506733]we've posted a more reader-friendly summary of what's included in this update in another announcement.[/url]

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the latest Awesomenauts update!

[h1]Update 4.4[/h1]
Released on 5-10-2017

[b]NEW: Brawls[/b]
Patch 4.4 introduces a brand new matchmaking game mode: Brawls![quote]Brawls will present limited time opportunities to play with and against other players in special matchmade bouts with unique rulesets. From regular Awesomenauts matches on weird new maps to triple damage team deathmatch with only Rocco’s, Brawl is set up to spice up and diversify your Awesomenauts experience. 

We’ve seen a lot of players enjoying many wacky and weird game modes in custom games. There’s even been some very fun to watch tournaments (King of the Frogs comes to mind). Brawl will make that experience accessible by adding matchmaking, and rewards. Brawl will be a highly accessible purefun™ gamemode. Some characters might be grossly overpowered in some of these game modes, but in brawls that’s part of the fun!

Brawls will award Awesomepoints and experience, just like regular matches. The first 3 brawl matches, though, will award 4 times as much![/quote][b]NEW: Daily  Missions[/b]
Daily missions are random objectives that will award you with Awesomepoints when you complete them. You can have up to 3 Daily Missions available to you and a brand new mission will appear each day.[quote]Daily Missions will appear in the main menu and will have various different types of objectives and reward amounts. Some missions might require you to play a random character, while others will ask you to deal a specified amount of damage to enemy turrets. You will be able to complete these objectives in both the Co-op versus Bots and Online Match game modes.

To keep overall Awesomepoints gain the same now that Daily Missions are introduced, Awesomepoints gain for matches has been reduced.[/quote]
[b]NEW: Main Menu Tiles[/b]
Main Menu Tiles are banners in the main menu that point you to various aspects of the game. The game will try to figure out what kind of information is appropriate for you and will then show a tile for it. For example, tiles will alert you when a character is close to leveling up, or advise a certain game mode.

[b]NEW: Skill aiming visuals[/b]
In order to help players see where their skills will end up, we’ve added aiming visuals for almost all of them. Some characters already had these visuals, like the Lunge for Deadlift or skills which require charging such as Lonestar’s Dynamite. Now when you hold down the action button to trigger a skill, you’ll see it’s effect visualized in the game. Letting go will then trigger the skill. Of course if you feel you don’t need it and want skills to trigger just that bit faster, you can turn it off in the settings.

Known issues:
[list][*]Penny dash distance prediction not accurate
[*]Clunk bite aim shown on wrong side of character when aiming backwards
[*]Froggy dash icon is not shown as disabled while tornado is active[/list]

[b]NEW premium skin: Soulhuntress Raelynn[/b]
[quote][i]Whoever said 'The enemy of my enemy is my friend' sure never met Soulhuntress Raelynn. Though she spends her days hunting demons, cultists, and other evil scum (which lots of folk appreciate), she's not particularly nice company at parties and friendly get-togethers. One time she attended a feast some villagers organized in her honor and she used her laser rifle to 'cleanse' the demon-shaped chocolate cake the villagers had spent days to prepare for her in secret. In the end, she's just not a people person, and most people have learned to leave her alone and not invite her to their parties.

She is GREAT friends with Cuddles though. Together they've cleansed more demons and other evildoers from this world than you'd feel comfortable knowing. And a chocolate cake.[/i][/quote]

This is a paid DLC and comes with a fully customized voice set and a portrait! http://store.steampowered.com/app/605940/Awesomenauts__Soulhuntress_Raelynn_Skin/

[b]NEW announcer: Ringmaster Announcer[/b]
[quote][i]Ladies and Gentlenauts, welcome to Cirque du Brawlee! It's a brand new show in the greatest big top of the galaxy. Step right up, step right up!

The Zork family is proud to present you tonight's entertainment: a feast of slaughter, daring adventures, and violence! We'll keep you on the edge of your seat as the intrepid heroes perform for you in our Circus. Witness the marvel of twenty Nauts plunging through the air - sans safety net! Gasp when you see our throng of clowns plummet to their seeming deaths, all to make you laugh, dear paying audience! But don't worry, all of it is completely safe... for you![/i][/quote]http://store.steampowered.com/app/399837/Awesomenauts__The_Ringmaster_Announcer/

[b]NEW portraits[/b]
Several new portraits have been added in this update. These can be unlocked with AwesomePoints:[list][*]Borble Birk
[*]Little Johny
[*]Hawk bomb
[*]Katy Kork
[*]Rob Bourgogne
[*]Don Steward[/list]

[b]General[/b][list][*]Reduced startup time in case of certain rather rare router settings
[*]Fixed a rare crash in replays if the chatlog was corrupted.
[*]Baby Kuri Mammoth, now also affects the duration of chains.[/list]

[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Lowered the glass platform in front of the front bottom turrets to make sure all ‘Nauts can jump up into that hide area.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Toning down some of the recent changes which turned Ayla players into Evil Eye + DoT cannons, and make Rage a bit more viable again.[/i][list][*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 7%>14%>21%>28%>35% to 10%>16%>22%>28%>34%.
[*]Jail Food, damage over time reduced from 120 to 105 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Commander_Rocket_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b][list][*]Base speed reduced by 7%.
[*]Rocket launch, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 25%.
[*]Rocket Launch, no longer knocks back enemies.
[*]Mad Bomb, now increases self-knockback by 30%.
[*]Scorched cigar pouch, slow reduction from 12.5% to 10% per stage.
[*]Nuke bug, now reduces the self-knockback as well as the damage of Rocket launch by 30%.
[*]Liquid MRE, loading speed increase reduced from +50% to +30%, price reduced from 280 to 220.
[*]Liquid MRE, no longer framerate dependent.
[*]Box of Cirean Cigars, split into two stages, adding 20 damage each for 145 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b]
[i]Triple Cowbells of Honor (-shield decay rate) stimulates trying to keep the Protective Pose shield active, while players are better off activating it when needed and starting the cooldown when it’s not needed. This replacement better fits this playstyle and adds to the skill ceiling by giving players further control over their shield.[/i][list][*]Triple Cowbells of Honor, now reduces the cooldown of Protective Pose by 30% if the shield is cancelled manually.[/list]
[i]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook is underwhelming compared to his other options[/i][list][*]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook, Movement speed increase buffed from 20% to 25%, duration increased from 2 to 3 seconds.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Slight reduction of Dizzy’s powerful clearing during midgame.[/i]
-”Dizzy’s greatest hits”, damage increase now only affects Awesomenauts.
[i]Dizzy’s auto-attack base DPS is really weak. She’s supposed to be low-damage/low-risk, but it was a bit too much[/i][list][*]Bubble Shot, damage increased from 65 to 70.
[*]Blowfish Nozzle, static bubble duration increased from 1.5s to 2s, price increased to 175.
[*]Slimy Markers, price reduced from 155 to 125 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b]
[i]Since Twister Tweeters (explosion at end of Tornado) is very popular, the Tornado duration upgrade is considered very weak. This is because it postpones the Tweeters effect. If duration also allows for cancellation, it would allow players to trigger the Tweeters effect themselves. Additionally it would improve the ability against teams who have stuns to interrupt Tornado.[/i][list][*]Bio Fuel cells, now also allows for cancelling the tornado after 1.6 second into the ability.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b]
[i]While The last Pieridae Transformae is reasonably popular, it is one of the weakest options in the row as it makes Genji waste his most powerful skill on droids. Since it is unique and thematic we would like to keep it in some form though.[/i][list][*]The last Pieridae Transformae, now always produces a flying droid. Also makes Cocoon kill all types of droids.[/list]
[i]Attempt to rebalance the Blessing row.[/i][list][*]Blessing, base duration reverted from 2.5s to 3s.
[*]The Cat Pillar, healing reduced to 100 per stage, price reduced to 175 per stage.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, now increases damage of affected allies by +8%.
[*]Kremzon Calendar, cooldown reduction increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds per stage.
[*]Gettin’ Out of Da Hood, speed-up reduced to 20%.
[*]Hidden Leaves, price reduced to 175 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Popular but on the weak side, Storm Drum could use a buff.[/i][list][*]Storm Drum, price reduced from 160 to 130 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b]
[i]Reduce price of DPS weedling items significantly, as they are outclassed by more burst-oriented and more efficient items.[/i][list][*]Corrosive spores, price reduced from 180 to 150 per stage.
[*]Flex neck, price reduced from 150 to 120 per stage.[/list]
[i]Some tweaks to improve the item balance on his base attack row[/i][list][*]Bite, damage duration reduced from 5s to 4s.
[*]Rotten teeth, damage duration decrease removed, price reduced from 225 to 195 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Adjustments to make bond a little less overbearing.[/i][list][*]Psionic Bond, maximum enemy tether length reduced by 20%.
[*]Displace, swap time reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.[/list]
[i]A slight buff to an underwhelming upgrade[/i][list][*]Time Travelled diamond, damage increased from +12% to +15% per stage.
[*]Root tea, effect duration increased to 3 seconds.
[*]Overexposed nature photo, now also gives Ix 50% of the healing done to allies when bonded.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b]
[i]This upgrade is a downgrade in many cases, because of how the damage is spread.[/i][list][*]Micey and the Missile factory, base missile is no longer reduced in damage by this upgrade.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b]
[i]Surprise Party Mask (+damage out of stealth) is too expensive for what it does[/i][list][*]Surprise Party Mask, merged to one stage of +110 damage for 200 Solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sheriff_Lonestar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b][list][*]Dynamite throw, collision size vs. characters increased by 15%.
[*]Missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Another missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Height per jump increased by 8%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b]
[i]Drawing speed is hardly a problem for Rocco, so the Birdseed Donuts (reduced draw speed) upgrade is very unpopular. It also makes lob-shots harder to pull off, which are a popular way of making arrow shots harder to dodge.[/i][list][*]Birdseed Donuts, now reduces the cooldown of vengeance by 2s for hitting a precision shot, and extends vengeance by 1s if it is active.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Scoop_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]The Holy Cup has become the way to go in high level play as the benefits are huge for a close-knit team.[/i][list][*]The Holy Cup, ally healing reduced from 75% to 65% of self healing.[/list]
[i]This upgrade gives too little compared to other upgrades in the same row, also too expensive.[/i][list][*]Chain mail Tunic, attack speed increase increased from +8% to 10% per stage.[/list]
[i]A slight tweak to make this upgrade trigger a little less often[/i][list][*]Titanium Coneshield, reduced health Scoop needs to be below from 80% to 75%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Teleport Beacon, explosion radius increased by 25%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade used to be useful for unintended extra burst damage for the Teleport Beacon ability, until it received a significant arming time in a recent update. This modification should make it more viable again[/i][list][*]Circuits of Time, decoy arming time reduced from 2 to 1 second, fixed collision detection.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Bash 3rd punch, replaced ceiling detection hack with actual smaller collision vs. obstacles.
[*]Stolen couch, range reduced from +5 to +4, price reduced from 190 to 170 solar
[*]Small Volcano, price reduced from 225 to 205 solar.
[*]Electric hammer, snare duration reduced from 0.5s to 0.35s, price reduced from 220 to 200 solar.
[*]Bash, base damage increased by 10%
[*]Chunk of salted meat, damage reduced from +13% to +10% per stage, price reduced from 215 to 195 per stage.
[*]Pale Mead, now increases damage of third punch, +70 damage for 280 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Magic Sunballs, price reduced from 220 to 195 solar.
[*]Sawblade, damage is now dealt through a fast 0.1 second DoT to prevent it from stacking with Spare Blade damage.
[*]Fixed that on the minimap Totem showed a glass platform above it.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b][list][*]Fixed Pyromancer Smiles’ splash art not being large enough in the end of game screen.
[*]Fixed that flamethrower sound kept playing if Smiles started teleporting while shooting.
[*]Pocket Dog, damage over time per stage reduced from 100 to 90.
[*]Bush Fire, damage per flame reduced from 31 to 28.
[*]Tail Whip, damage reduced from 300 to 280.
[*]Tail Whip, stun duration reduced from 0.2 to 0.1 seconds.
[*]Unicornian Butt, stun duration increase reduced from 0.3 to 0.2 seconds, price increased from 200 to 240.
[*]Trapper's Hook, duration is now affected by Baby Kuri Mammoth.
[*]Base health, reduced from 1650 to 1550.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b][list][*]Titanium spikes damage increase increased from +10% to +12% per stage.
[*]Chrono rift, cooldown reduction increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds, for 165 solar per stage.
[*]Flash forward, no longer decreases bubble duration.
[*]Giant Monocle, range increase decreased from 27% to 22%.
[*]Instant charge battery, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]Flyswatter, now adds a non-stacking DoT to laser which deals 80 damage over 4 seconds.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.
[*]Wraith Stone, replaced by Barrier Magazine.[/list]

[b]Modding new features[/b][list][*]Particles can now be modded. You can edit them in the Particle Editor and include them in your mods. To access the Particle Editor you must be in a map editing session on a map that is part of a mod. Press F2 to open it. Press “New” to create a new particle template. Modded particles can be used in levels through the Particle object.
[*]Can now override default turret health through the new setting [i]healthOverride[/i].
[*]Can now override turret shoot cooldown through the new setting [i]shootCooldownOverride[/i]. Note that turret shooting speed is limited to 10 bullets per second for stability reasons.
[*]Can now add additional damage to turret bullets through the new setting [i]additionalDamage[/i]. By setting negative numbers here you can even create healing turrets now.
[*]Can now override what bullets a turret shoots through the new setting [i]overrideBulletSettings[/i]. Note that not all bullet types actually work with turrets, but most do. (Holy cow, turrets shooting Derpl Nukes are scary!)
[*]Can now override at what distance a turrets starts aiming and shooting at characters through the new setting [i]targetingRangeOverride[/i].
[*]Can now swap the default orientation of turrets through the new setting [i]swapDefaultOrientation[/i].
[*]Can now hide turrets from the minimap through the new setting [i]showOnMiniMap[/i].
[*]Can now let Buttons turn Turrets on/off through the new setting [i]activationInfluencedBy[/i].
[*]Buttons can now turn Particle objects on/off.
[*]Tutorial textures and animations can now be used in modded maps.[/list]

[b]Modding fixes[/b][list][*]Fixed that the [i]hideByButton[/i] option in Texture objects didn’t work if anything in the Texture was animated, and didn’t combine correctly with setting a colour on the Texture.
[*]Fixed that if [i]opacity[/i] and [i]colour[/i] were both set on an Animation object, then particles inside the animation would not update their colour correctly anymore.
[*]Fixed that automatically reloading textures while editing a modded map didn’t work. (Works both in DirectX and OpenGL, but not on Linux and Mac.)
[*]Fixed that when browsing Animations or Particles they were positioned too high, half over the button above.
[*]Fixed mod preset not being selected by default when editing a map.[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for Update 4.4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee is now available! The patch notes for this update are included below, but [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1469721435682506733]we've posted a more reader-friendly summary of what's included in this update in another announcement.[/url]

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the latest Awesomenauts update!

[h1]Update 4.4[/h1]
Released on 5-10-2017

[b]NEW: Brawls[/b]
Patch 4.4 introduces a brand new matchmaking game mode: Brawls![quote]Brawls will present limited time opportunities to play with and against other players in special matchmade bouts with unique rulesets. From regular Awesomenauts matches on weird new maps to triple damage team deathmatch with only Rocco’s, Brawl is set up to spice up and diversify your Awesomenauts experience. 

We’ve seen a lot of players enjoying many wacky and weird game modes in custom games. There’s even been some very fun to watch tournaments (King of the Frogs comes to mind). Brawl will make that experience accessible by adding matchmaking, and rewards. Brawl will be a highly accessible purefun™ gamemode. Some characters might be grossly overpowered in some of these game modes, but in brawls that’s part of the fun!

Brawls will award Awesomepoints and experience, just like regular matches. The first 3 brawl matches, though, will award 4 times as much![/quote][b]NEW: Daily  Missions[/b]
Daily missions are random objectives that will award you with Awesomepoints when you complete them. You can have up to 3 Daily Missions available to you and a brand new mission will appear each day.[quote]Daily Missions will appear in the main menu and will have various different types of objectives and reward amounts. Some missions might require you to play a random character, while others will ask you to deal a specified amount of damage to enemy turrets. You will be able to complete these objectives in both the Co-op versus Bots and Online Match game modes.

To keep overall Awesomepoints gain the same now that Daily Missions are introduced, Awesomepoints gain for matches has been reduced.[/quote]
[b]NEW: Main Menu Tiles[/b]
Main Menu Tiles are banners in the main menu that point you to various aspects of the game. The game will try to figure out what kind of information is appropriate for you and will then show a tile for it. For example, tiles will alert you when a character is close to leveling up, or advise a certain game mode.

[b]NEW: Skill aiming visuals[/b]
In order to help players see where their skills will end up, we’ve added aiming visuals for almost all of them. Some characters already had these visuals, like the Lunge for Deadlift or skills which require charging such as Lonestar’s Dynamite. Now when you hold down the action button to trigger a skill, you’ll see it’s effect visualized in the game. Letting go will then trigger the skill. Of course if you feel you don’t need it and want skills to trigger just that bit faster, you can turn it off in the settings.

Known issues:
[list][*]Penny dash distance prediction not accurate
[*]Clunk bite aim shown on wrong side of character when aiming backwards
[*]Froggy dash icon is not shown as disabled while tornado is active[/list]

[b]NEW premium skin: Soulhuntress Raelynn[/b]
[quote][i]Whoever said 'The enemy of my enemy is my friend' sure never met Soulhuntress Raelynn. Though she spends her days hunting demons, cultists, and other evil scum (which lots of folk appreciate), she's not particularly nice company at parties and friendly get-togethers. One time she attended a feast some villagers organized in her honor and she used her laser rifle to 'cleanse' the demon-shaped chocolate cake the villagers had spent days to prepare for her in secret. In the end, she's just not a people person, and most people have learned to leave her alone and not invite her to their parties.

She is GREAT friends with Cuddles though. Together they've cleansed more demons and other evildoers from this world than you'd feel comfortable knowing. And a chocolate cake.[/i][/quote]

This is a paid DLC and comes with a fully customized voice set and a portrait! http://store.steampowered.com/app/605940/Awesomenauts__Soulhuntress_Raelynn_Skin/

[b]NEW announcer: Ringmaster Announcer[/b]
[quote][i]Ladies and Gentlenauts, welcome to Cirque du Brawlee! It's a brand new show in the greatest big top of the galaxy. Step right up, step right up!

The Zork family is proud to present you tonight's entertainment: a feast of slaughter, daring adventures, and violence! We'll keep you on the edge of your seat as the intrepid heroes perform for you in our Circus. Witness the marvel of twenty Nauts plunging through the air - sans safety net! Gasp when you see our throng of clowns plummet to their seeming deaths, all to make you laugh, dear paying audience! But don't worry, all of it is completely safe... for you![/i][/quote]http://store.steampowered.com/app/399837/Awesomenauts__The_Ringmaster_Announcer/

[b]NEW portraits[/b]
Several new portraits have been added in this update. These can be unlocked with AwesomePoints:[list][*]Borble Birk
[*]Little Johny
[*]Hawk bomb
[*]Katy Kork
[*]Rob Bourgogne
[*]Don Steward[/list]

[b]General[/b][list][*]Reduced startup time in case of certain rather rare router settings
[*]Fixed a rare crash in replays if the chatlog was corrupted.
[*]Baby Kuri Mammoth, now also affects the duration of chains.[/list]

[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Lowered the glass platform in front of the front bottom turrets to make sure all ‘Nauts can jump up into that hide area.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Toning down some of the recent changes which turned Ayla players into Evil Eye + DoT cannons, and make Rage a bit more viable again.[/i][list][*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 7%>14%>21%>28%>35% to 10%>16%>22%>28%>34%.
[*]Jail Food, damage over time reduced from 120 to 105 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Commander_Rocket_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b][list][*]Base speed reduced by 7%.
[*]Rocket launch, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 25%.
[*]Rocket Launch, no longer knocks back enemies.
[*]Mad Bomb, now increases self-knockback by 30%.
[*]Scorched cigar pouch, slow reduction from 12.5% to 10% per stage.
[*]Nuke bug, now reduces the self-knockback as well as the damage of Rocket launch by 30%.
[*]Liquid MRE, loading speed increase reduced from +50% to +30%, price reduced from 280 to 220.
[*]Liquid MRE, no longer framerate dependent.
[*]Box of Cirean Cigars, split into two stages, adding 20 damage each for 145 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b]
[i]Triple Cowbells of Honor (-shield decay rate) stimulates trying to keep the Protective Pose shield active, while players are better off activating it when needed and starting the cooldown when it’s not needed. This replacement better fits this playstyle and adds to the skill ceiling by giving players further control over their shield.[/i][list][*]Triple Cowbells of Honor, now reduces the cooldown of Protective Pose by 30% if the shield is cancelled manually.[/list]
[i]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook is underwhelming compared to his other options[/i][list][*]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook, Movement speed increase buffed from 20% to 25%, duration increased from 2 to 3 seconds.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Slight reduction of Dizzy’s powerful clearing during midgame.[/i]
-”Dizzy’s greatest hits”, damage increase now only affects Awesomenauts.
[i]Dizzy’s auto-attack base DPS is really weak. She’s supposed to be low-damage/low-risk, but it was a bit too much[/i][list][*]Bubble Shot, damage increased from 65 to 70.
[*]Blowfish Nozzle, static bubble duration increased from 1.5s to 2s, price increased to 175.
[*]Slimy Markers, price reduced from 155 to 125 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b]
[i]Since Twister Tweeters (explosion at end of Tornado) is very popular, the Tornado duration upgrade is considered very weak. This is because it postpones the Tweeters effect. If duration also allows for cancellation, it would allow players to trigger the Tweeters effect themselves. Additionally it would improve the ability against teams who have stuns to interrupt Tornado.[/i][list][*]Bio Fuel cells, now also allows for cancelling the tornado after 1.6 second into the ability.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b]
[i]While The last Pieridae Transformae is reasonably popular, it is one of the weakest options in the row as it makes Genji waste his most powerful skill on droids. Since it is unique and thematic we would like to keep it in some form though.[/i][list][*]The last Pieridae Transformae, now always produces a flying droid. Also makes Cocoon kill all types of droids.[/list]
[i]Attempt to rebalance the Blessing row.[/i][list][*]Blessing, base duration reverted from 2.5s to 3s.
[*]The Cat Pillar, healing reduced to 100 per stage, price reduced to 175 per stage.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, now increases damage of affected allies by +8%.
[*]Kremzon Calendar, cooldown reduction increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds per stage.
[*]Gettin’ Out of Da Hood, speed-up reduced to 20%.
[*]Hidden Leaves, price reduced to 175 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Popular but on the weak side, Storm Drum could use a buff.[/i][list][*]Storm Drum, price reduced from 160 to 130 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b]
[i]Reduce price of DPS weedling items significantly, as they are outclassed by more burst-oriented and more efficient items.[/i][list][*]Corrosive spores, price reduced from 180 to 150 per stage.
[*]Flex neck, price reduced from 150 to 120 per stage.[/list]
[i]Some tweaks to improve the item balance on his base attack row[/i][list][*]Bite, damage duration reduced from 5s to 4s.
[*]Rotten teeth, damage duration decrease removed, price reduced from 225 to 195 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Adjustments to make bond a little less overbearing.[/i][list][*]Psionic Bond, maximum enemy tether length reduced by 20%.
[*]Displace, swap time reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.[/list]
[i]A slight buff to an underwhelming upgrade[/i][list][*]Time Travelled diamond, damage increased from +12% to +15% per stage.
[*]Root tea, effect duration increased to 3 seconds.
[*]Overexposed nature photo, now also gives Ix 50% of the healing done to allies when bonded.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b]
[i]This upgrade is a downgrade in many cases, because of how the damage is spread.[/i][list][*]Micey and the Missile factory, base missile is no longer reduced in damage by this upgrade.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b]
[i]Surprise Party Mask (+damage out of stealth) is too expensive for what it does[/i][list][*]Surprise Party Mask, merged to one stage of +110 damage for 200 Solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sheriff_Lonestar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b][list][*]Dynamite throw, collision size vs. characters increased by 15%.
[*]Missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Another missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Height per jump increased by 8%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b]
[i]Drawing speed is hardly a problem for Rocco, so the Birdseed Donuts (reduced draw speed) upgrade is very unpopular. It also makes lob-shots harder to pull off, which are a popular way of making arrow shots harder to dodge.[/i][list][*]Birdseed Donuts, now reduces the cooldown of vengeance by 2s for hitting a precision shot, and extends vengeance by 1s if it is active.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Scoop_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]The Holy Cup has become the way to go in high level play as the benefits are huge for a close-knit team.[/i][list][*]The Holy Cup, ally healing reduced from 75% to 65% of self healing.[/list]
[i]This upgrade gives too little compared to other upgrades in the same row, also too expensive.[/i][list][*]Chain mail Tunic, attack speed increase increased from +8% to 10% per stage.[/list]
[i]A slight tweak to make this upgrade trigger a little less often[/i][list][*]Titanium Coneshield, reduced health Scoop needs to be below from 80% to 75%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Teleport Beacon, explosion radius increased by 25%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade used to be useful for unintended extra burst damage for the Teleport Beacon ability, until it received a significant arming time in a recent update. This modification should make it more viable again[/i][list][*]Circuits of Time, decoy arming time reduced from 2 to 1 second, fixed collision detection.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Bash 3rd punch, replaced ceiling detection hack with actual smaller collision vs. obstacles.
[*]Stolen couch, range reduced from +5 to +4, price reduced from 190 to 170 solar
[*]Small Volcano, price reduced from 225 to 205 solar.
[*]Electric hammer, snare duration reduced from 0.5s to 0.35s, price reduced from 220 to 200 solar.
[*]Bash, base damage increased by 10%
[*]Chunk of salted meat, damage reduced from +13% to +10% per stage, price reduced from 215 to 195 per stage.
[*]Pale Mead, now increases damage of third punch, +70 damage for 280 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Magic Sunballs, price reduced from 220 to 195 solar.
[*]Sawblade, damage is now dealt through a fast 0.1 second DoT to prevent it from stacking with Spare Blade damage.
[*]Fixed that on the minimap Totem showed a glass platform above it.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b][list][*]Fixed Pyromancer Smiles’ splash art not being large enough in the end of game screen.
[*]Fixed that flamethrower sound kept playing if Smiles started teleporting while shooting.
[*]Pocket Dog, damage over time per stage reduced from 100 to 90.
[*]Bush Fire, damage per flame reduced from 31 to 28.
[*]Tail Whip, damage reduced from 300 to 280.
[*]Tail Whip, stun duration reduced from 0.2 to 0.1 seconds.
[*]Unicornian Butt, stun duration increase reduced from 0.3 to 0.2 seconds, price increased from 200 to 240.
[*]Trapper's Hook, duration is now affected by Baby Kuri Mammoth.
[*]Base health, reduced from 1650 to 1550.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b][list][*]Titanium spikes damage increase increased from +10% to +12% per stage.
[*]Chrono rift, cooldown reduction increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds, for 165 solar per stage.
[*]Flash forward, no longer decreases bubble duration.
[*]Giant Monocle, range increase decreased from 27% to 22%.
[*]Instant charge battery, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]Flyswatter, now adds a non-stacking DoT to laser which deals 80 damage over 4 seconds.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.
[*]Wraith Stone, replaced by Barrier Magazine.[/list]

[b]Modding new features[/b][list][*]Particles can now be modded. You can edit them in the Particle Editor and include them in your mods. To access the Particle Editor you must be in a map editing session on a map that is part of a mod. Press F2 to open it. Press “New” to create a new particle template. Modded particles can be used in levels through the Particle object.
[*]Can now override default turret health through the new setting [i]healthOverride[/i].
[*]Can now override turret shoot cooldown through the new setting [i]shootCooldownOverride[/i]. Note that turret shooting speed is limited to 10 bullets per second for stability reasons.
[*]Can now add additional damage to turret bullets through the new setting [i]additionalDamage[/i]. By setting negative numbers here you can even create healing turrets now.
[*]Can now override what bullets a turret shoots through the new setting [i]overrideBulletSettings[/i]. Note that not all bullet types actually work with turrets, but most do. (Holy cow, turrets shooting Derpl Nukes are scary!)
[*]Can now override at what distance a turrets starts aiming and shooting at characters through the new setting [i]targetingRangeOverride[/i].
[*]Can now swap the default orientation of turrets through the new setting [i]swapDefaultOrientation[/i].
[*]Can now hide turrets from the minimap through the new setting [i]showOnMiniMap[/i].
[*]Can now let Buttons turn Turrets on/off through the new setting [i]activationInfluencedBy[/i].
[*]Buttons can now turn Particle objects on/off.
[*]Tutorial textures and animations can now be used in modded maps.[/list]

[b]Modding fixes[/b][list][*]Fixed that the [i]hideByButton[/i] option in Texture objects didn’t work if anything in the Texture was animated, and didn’t combine correctly with setting a colour on the Texture.
[*]Fixed that if [i]opacity[/i] and [i]colour[/i] were both set on an Animation object, then particles inside the animation would not update their colour correctly anymore.
[*]Fixed that automatically reloading textures while editing a modded map didn’t work. (Works both in DirectX and OpenGL, but not on Linux and Mac.)
[*]Fixed that when browsing Animations or Particles they were positioned too high, half over the button above.
[*]Fixed mod preset not being selected by default when editing a map.[/list]

Instant charge battery, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar per stage.
Flyswatter, now adds a non-stacking DoT to laser which deals 80 damage over 4 seconds.
Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.
Wraith Stone, replaced by Barrier Magazine.

tags.feature: Particles can now be modded. You can edit them in the Particle Editor and include them in your mods.
Can now override default turret health through the new setting [i]healthOverride[/i].
Can now override turret shoot cooldown through the new setting [i]shootCooldownOverride[/i].
Can now add additional damage to turret bullets through the new setting [i]additionalDamage[/i].
Can now override what bullets a turret shoots through the new setting [i]overrideBulletSettings[/i].
Can now override at what distance a turrets starts aiming and shooting at characters through the new setting [i]targetingRangeOverride[/i].
Can now swap the default orientation of turrets through the new setting [i]swapDefaultOrientation[/i].
Can now hide turrets from the minimap through the new setting [i]showOnMiniMap[/i].
Can now let Buttons turn Turrets on/off through the new setting [i]activationInfluencedBy[/i].
Buttons can now turn Particle objects on/off.
Tutorial textures and animations can now be used in modded maps.

tags.bug: Fixed that the [i]hideByButton[/i] option in Texture objects didn’t work if anything in the Texture was animated, and didn’t combine correctly with setting a colour on the Texture.
Fixed that if [i]opacity[/i] and [i]colour[/i] were both set on an Animation object, then particles inside the animation would not update their colour correctly anymore.
Fixed that automatically reloading textures while editing a modded map didn’t work.
Fixed that when browsing Animations or Particles they were positioned too high, half over the button above.
Fixed mod preset not being selected by default when editing a map.

notes.title: Update 4.4 Open Beta Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Welcome to Cirque du Brawlee! Awesomenauts 4.4 brings a massive batch of cool new features, and the Open Beta is available to all players right now for to try them out.

On the Streamisho today, we unveiled the biggest feature coming in Update 4.4: Weekly Brawls! Every week we'll have a new event for you to play, and during the Open Beta we'll be testing a whole bunch of them. Once Update 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee launches, these Weekly Brawls will be live from every Thursday until late Sunday... and you're getting a new Brawl every weekend.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e876624a01b6b62c9a5d0de91e2683328bea61e5.jpg[/img]
To kick things off, the Beta currently has the Girl Power Brawl active. This boils down to a regular match of 'Nauts, but you only have access to female 'Nauts. That means your selection is limited to Coco, Raelynn, Penny, Nibbs, Dizzy, Ayla, and Ksenia!

The Brawl available in the Beta will change in a few days, allowing you to try out some of the other Brawls we've got lined up for you. We'll keep them a surprise for now... but how does an All-Rocco Deathmatch sound, for starters?

On top of these Brawls, the Open Beta also includes the features we revealed last week. Try out some of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/2888353506904449965]new Daily Missions and the new Livetiles in the main menu[/url], and give us your feedback on the extensive balance changes that are included in this update.[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2f406ceee48724da80db6788a6a88efe0cd6d931.jpg[/img]
To access the Open Beta, all you have to do is follow these steps:

[olist][*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your library and select "Properties"
[*]In the DLC tab, make sure the "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load PC" is checked. If you're playing or Mac or Linux, tab the DLC for that OS instead.
[*]Head to the "Beta" tab and switch to "beta - public channel".
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY".[/olist]
If you want to discuss these balance tweaks or want to share your thoughts on other features in the Beta, please head over to [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19]the Official Awesomenauts forum[/url]. While we try to gather feedback from all our different channels, it's easier for us to keep track of the different opinions and arguments [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19]if the discussions are centralized[/url]![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/3423c5916f19095905eb42cb4ceb2af06d98f3e3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Daily missions coming in Update 4.4!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/327d7a74c15752071322017a38b217a8e908e51f.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.4 is right around the corner! This action-packed update will go into Beta next week, on September 20th, and we've already revealed the first couple of features that are included on the Streamisho!
[list][*][b]Daily Missions[/b] - Starting in Update 4.4, you'll receive a new mission every day. These missions challenge you to play or win a certain number of games, play certain game modes, try out different characters from a specific roster, and more. Completing a mission will earn you a sweet Awesomepoint bonus. For new players, these missions will be aimed at helping them understand and explore what Awesomenauts has to offer, while more experienced players will receive missions that focus on winning matches![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/116275d0e47dfcdcfa8de596d96fd54e8c3928cf.png[/img]
[*][b]Overhauled main menu[/b] - We're giving the main menu a new lick of paint! Once you log in after Awesomenauts 4.4 has gone live, you'll notice that the main menu not only lists your currently active missions, but a bunch of additional tiles also highlight your recent accomplishments, milestones you're close to completing, and various other aspects of the game worth highlighting![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bad65530fc20987f6c31eef37dad346d3b6c107a.png[/img]
[*][b]New modding features![/b] - The modding community continues to create awesome new mods (like [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1131788785]this awesome Ghostbusters mod by EgyptFalcon[/url]) and we want to provide them with the tools to make their mods even better! In Update 4.4, we're adding the ability to add custom particles to your mods, as well as change turret settings. Want to create a turret that shoots Derpl nukes? Now you can! Want to create a cool mod where a turret shoots at players to heal them? Say no more! We've got you covered![/list]

Interested in how all of this looks in practice? Catch the VOD for the Streamisho! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G4DQSMoPIGc And that's not all! The biggest feature we're adding in the update is still a secret! Come back next week to learn all about the update and try it out in the Open Beta for yourself![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/83112268dd181c322a847536fbabbed7fa9b3b2b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Anniversary Celebration Schedule
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e1d450f69e07c17946d5e6546ad59114d8e34a04.png[/img]As we announced last week, we'll be [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1451700696562231579]celebrating the fifth anniversary of Awesomenauts on Steam throughout the month of August[/url]. We launched the first weekend event last Thursday, but that was just first step! Every weekend throughout the month you'll be able to enjoy a quadruple First win of the Day bonus!

Additionally, log in during the remaining weekends this month and you'll get a different free skin every week. It's yours to keep, forever!

Finally, as we head to Cologne ourselves to participate in Gamescom with our biggest booth ever, you'll be able to access every 'Naut in the game for a full week to experience the full Awesomenauts cast for free! This event will start on Augusts 21st, and last all the way through August 27th!

Thanks again for all your support over the last couple of years, and we hope you'll join us for these celebrations throughout the month!

Need reminders about these events? Keep an eye on our social channels to stay up to date!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9f8c73f6f85e9820436ef89fd97b79e31d138a5d.png[/img]
We just released Awesomenauts 4.2.1, a hotfix for the recently-released 4.2 update! This update adresses some bugs related character skills, upgrades, and other issues!

Thanks to everyone who reported issues and provided feedback on the recent changes. Please continue to let us know what you think of Smiles  Catch the patch notes below:

[h1][b]Update 4.2.1 hotfix[/b][/h1]

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]Using a controller no longer results in selecting five different buttons in the dropdown from the main menu screen. 
[*]Fixed that you couldn’t select the announcer dropdown in the in-game pause screen with a controller.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that 3rd punch was unable to damage structures.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b]
[i]Released in a slightly too powerful state, some changes to tone down his problematic Trapper’s Hook skill[/i][list]
[*]Fixed the levelling unlock order for Piggybank and Barrier magazine upgrades.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, range reduced by 20%.
[*]Hook, reel in time increased from 0.7s to 2s, now scales with Bush Telly.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, projectile speed reduced by 20%.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, minimum rope length increased by 25%.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, will no longer pull a Nibbs performing fire breath.
[*]-Electric Magnetic Winch upgrade, range increase reduced from 25% to 20%.
[*]-Sandworm Tail upgrade, bonus damage reduced from 50% to 40%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that Stormdrum would always show a healing effect, even without buying Caterpillar King statue.
[*]Fixed that the butterfly shot would not return after buying the Wool Shawl and Glow Bracelets upgrades.
[*]Fixed that the cocoon would immediately kill an enemy droid when The last pieridae transformae upgrade was bought[/list]

notes.title: AWESOMENAUTS 4.2 - OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/c6427cfa411bf19c5a69138c86a74b0d274860ae.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! is available NOW on Steam! A new character, new portraits, and a huge amount of improvements! Play now and take out Smiles for a spin! If you already own the All Nauts Pack, Smiles will be automatically unlocked for you!

Don't have the All Nauts pack yet? No worries! You can also unlock him with Awesomepoints if you've been saving up!

The latest update is the second one we're releasing this summer and there's a lot more coming up! Stay tuned for more news about awesome content launching beyond Update 4.2!

In addition to Smiles joining the Awesomenauts, we're also releasing a pretty awesome skin for him. Check out Pyromancer Smiles! http://store.steampowered.com/app/497621
Catch the full patch notes below!

[h1][b]Update 4.2[/b][/h1]
12-7-2017

[b]NEW Naut: Smiles[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i]
[list][*]Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
[*]Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel stail, knocking them away.
[*]Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.[/list]

[i]Short backstory:[/i]
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

[b]NEW skin: Pyromancer Smiles[/b]
Some crocodiles just want to watch the world burn. Pyromancer Smiles won't settle for that. He has peered into the flames and had visions of him setting all of creation ablaze! He's left the (now scorched) swamps of Ribbit II on a quest to fulfill this dark destiny, and stowed away on the Awesomenauts vessel to visit distant worlds. What's left standing after a battle is incinerated by the Pyromancer, until only ash remains.

He's dark, he's angry, and he's armed with a flamethrower. Don't cross Pyromancer Smiles as he'll burn you to a crisp! The Flames command it!

[b]NEW: added portraits[/b][list][*]Fire commander
[*]Ice commander
[*]Love commander
[*]Team power
[*]The collection
[*]Hairy King[/list]

[b]General[/b][list][*]The scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
[*]Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
[*]Fixed that sometimes after closing the Steam overlay and pressing enter to chat, it would register as a shift+enter instead, opening all chat instead of team chat.
[*]Fixed that if you moved the mouse very close to the centre of Coco and used her AA, her arms would extend in a different direction than her attack.
[*]There is a new, more streamlined tutorial flow for new players.
[*]Fixed that running on 1280x1024 or using the Screen Adjustment feature would cut off parts of the in-game HUD.
[*]Steam IDs are no longer logged while in character select, fixing that players could figure out who they were going to play against before the match actually started.
[*]Fixed that practice games could be joined via chat, for a short period.
[*]Fixed that banned players wouldn’t get a ‘cancelled’ notification when trying to queue[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b][list][*]Fixed that (some) counters for achievements would not update for some players.
[*]Fixed that the Slowwolf announcer would not be granted to a player that got the “Welcome back!” achievement in a beta.[/list]

[b]Menus[/b][list][*]Fixed that League 1 didn't exist for some older seasons in the leaderboad history.
[*]Depth issue fix for character icons in menus on Mac.
[*]Fixed that it was possible to get stuck in a state where all buttons in the Play menu are locked after trying to join a custom game of which the last slot was just taken by another player.
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking multiple times on a character profile picture in a lobby would result in an endless growing tooltip.
[*]The tooltip about the items that you can buy now correctly states level 3 instead of level 4 at which you have unlocked all items.[/list]

[b]Sound[/b][list][*]Optimised all sounds to use less space on disk and in memory and to load a bit quicker.
[*]The “test voice” button in the Armory now correctly plays voice lines of premium skins.
[*]Announcer voices and player-triggered character voices are now better audible.[/list]

[b]Bots[/b][list][*]Updated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots[/list]

[b]Modding[/b][list][*]Added a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. It is also possible to play local versus this way if only one of the local players switches team. This is an experimental feature that probably has a lot of issues, use at your own risk. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.
[*]Added an option to Button to only react to a specific character class.
[*]Added automatic backup to the map editor (once every two minutes and when exiting the editing session).
[*]Added an option to the AIDebugger (the F4 editor) to view detailed events about character gameplay. There is also an option to filter these events and to show them only for the selected character.
[*]Fixed a crash when using the WriteToTextbox AI block in combination with zero respawn time or switchClass/switchTeam.
[*]Fixed that actions and conditions weren’t sorted alphabetically in the BehaviourCreator tool.
[*]Fixed that AffectAreas, JumpPads and Shops didn’t become invisible in the editor when the “Gameplay objects” group was hidden.[/list]

[b]Thanks[/b]
For almost all of our updates since launch we’ve received extensive help from the community to discuss and point out balance issues and bugs. As always, we’re grateful for your input and we would hereby like to start highlighting community members for their efforts.

For this update in particular we say thanks to community members Gameinsky, Doppelganger, Sam! And Wakkabanana for their input, active Discord presence and willingness to provide input upon a wide range of balance topics.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Make it harder for Ayla to endlessly chase a single enemy in Rage mode, while keeping her teamfighting ability about the same. Also, fix a bug where 0 and 1 enemy target added the same amount of shielding.[/i][list][*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 15%>15%>20%>25%>30% to 7%>14%>21%>28%>35%
[*]Rage, self damage increased from 33 to 40.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.
[*]Rip-Apart Bear upgrade, self damage reduction increased from 18% to 25%per stage.[/list]
[i]Bring an overbuffed upgrade back down a little[/i][list][*]Jail Food upgrade, reduced damage over time from 135 to 120 per stage.[/list]
[i]Boost Ayla’s earlygame, and reduce her reliance on Angry Drawings[/i][list][*]Rage, base DPS increased from 252 to 276.
[*]Angry Drawings upgrade, damage increase reduced from 17% to 11%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Chucho Krokk[/b][list][*]One Armed Chameleon upgrade, bonus damage reduced from 90 to 85.
[*]Nitro Muffler upgrade, damage over time reduced from 180 to 170 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b][list][*]Iron Slam, the hud icon now indicates which punch will be next.
[*]Tweaked Bullbarian shield sounds.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b][list][*]Cat shot, base damage increased from 85 to 90.
[*]Fatcat upgrade, no longer affected by Longcat.
[*]Gave Derpl’s cats a moving tail for a better visual effect and feel.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b][list][*]Explosive Clone, arming time reduced from 1s to 0.9s.
[*]Torn D-Shirt upgrade, now only affects Awesomenauts.
[*]Golden G Necklace upgrade, after arming the Explosive Clone it stays in place for 1s until an enemy touches it.
[*]Removed a voiceline in which Dizzy said Froggy is her nephew, while he is her cousin.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b]
[i]Changes to make Frog a bit more safe while also reducing all or nothing potency with landing his whirlwind.[/i][list][*]Base health increased from 1150 to 1200.
[*]Dash, base damage increased from 250 to 280.
[*]Ice Cubes upgrade, slow per stage reduced from 15% to 12%, price reduced from 150 to 140.
[*]Clock Necklace upgrade, heal over time reduced from 140 to 120.
[*]Boombox upgrade, damage increase reduced from 16% to 13% per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list][*]Baby Kuri Mammoth now affects cocoon.
[*]Butterfly shot, fixed that returning projectile now also does 65 at base.
[*]Wool Shawl upgrade, range increase reduced from 40% to 30%.[/list]
[i]Slightly reduce the AA heal, but make stack with Praying Beads, Stormdrum and Space Hippo[/i][list][*]Caterpillar King statue upgrade, now adds ally heal to all Butterfly Shot damage output, 20% per stage.
[*]The Cat Pillar upgrade, heal amount reduced from 125 to 115 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list][*]Feather Ball upgrade, now adds a 3rd spit projectile.
[*]Fertilizer upgrade, now increases Weedling health by 20% and health regeneration by 50%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b][list][*]Salt Miner upgrade, damage per tick reduced from 18 to 16 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list][*]Micey the Mech Pilot upgrade, price increased from 125 to 150 solar.
[*]Micey and the Missile Factory upgrade, price reduced from 215 to 200 solar.
[*]Flip Arm Add-on, damage reduced from 13% to 11% per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b][list][*]Steel False Teeth upgrade, now gives Leon a shield that reduces 20% of incoming damage for 2 seconds when successfully landing tongue.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Max_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b][list][*]Galactic Police Scanner upgrade, damage increase reduced from 30% to 27%, price increased from 155 to 180.
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken unveiled! upgrade, fixed the issue where the last bullet would sometimes not spawn.
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken unveiled! upgrade, damage decreased from 150 to 120.
[*]Hairy King upgrade, size increased reduced from +15% to +10%[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Nibbs_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list][*]Eternal Flame upgrade, fixed issue that Starstorm Statue had no effect upon the fireballs.
[*]Red Sneakers upgrade, price reduced from 155 to 140, speed increase increased from 5% to 8%.
[*]Sunscreen Mouthwash upgrade, speed increase reduced from 100% to 75%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Sentient Rock upgrade, silence duration reduced from 0.3s to 0.25s per charge.
[*]Chicken in a Lunch Box upgrade, amplified damage increase reduced from 15% to 12%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list][*]Base attack, speed penalty for shooting reduced by 25%.[/list]
	
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b][list][*]Vengeance, cooldown reduced from 20 to 16 seconds.
[*]Cockfight Spurs upgrade, price reduced from 200 to 180 solar per stage.
[*]Chicken Grill upgrade, price reduced from 185 to 175 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Base movement, speed and acceleration increase by 5%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, cooldown increased from 10s to 11s.
[*]Bug Detector upgrade, now deals 200 damage over 4s when the shield hits an enemy.
[*]Night Vision Spywatch upgrade, movement speed increase reduced from 50% to 30%.
[*]Circuits of time upgrade, now requires 2s arming time before the clone explodes.
[*]Circuits of time upgrade, damage increased from 125 to 150.
[*]Circuits of time upgrade, clone health increased from 100 to 250.
[*]Not-So-Serious Tank upgrade, damage increase increased from 12% to 14%.
[*]Hacking Satellite upgrade, merged into single stage upgrade, reduces cooldown by 3s for 200 solar.
[*]Cyanide Cigarettes upgrade, price reduced from 185 to 170 solar per stage.
[*]Yellow King Pages upgrade, price reduced from 205 to 190 solar per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Homeless Gnome upgrade, fixed an issue where the Gnome would just dissipate if thrown too far.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Fixed the issue where the second stage of Voodoo Doll unintentionally added another second of slow.
[*]Magic Sunballs upgrade, extra targets reduced from 3 to 2, price reduced from 250 to 220.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Admiral_Swiggins_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Swiggins[/b][list][*]Ancient Octants upgrade, stun no longer applies to the whole area.
[*]Pneumatic Spoon upgrade, break damage increase reduced from 100 to 90 per stage.
[*]Bovinian Skimmed Milk upgrade, damage amplification reduced from 15% to 12%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b]
[i]Slight nerf to an upgrade which pushes Ted a little over the top.[/i][list][*]Commando Ted Figurine upgrade, damage increase reduced from 17 to 15% per stage for Machine gun, 13% to 11% for shotgun.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Vinnie_&_Spike_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Vinnie & Spike[/b][list][*]Antique Machinegun upgrade, silence duration reduced from 1.5s to 1s.
[*]Yakoiza upgrade, extra damage reduced from 71% to 62%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Voltar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Voltar[/b][list][*]Bombshell upgrade, damage reduced from 300 to 280, price increased from 130 to 150 per stage.
[*]Warpgate Overdrive upgrade, cooldown reduction increased from -1.5s to -1s.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b]
[i]Some quality of life mobility improvements to help Yuri, as over time some other characters have become faster as well.[/i][list][*]Air acceleration increased by 10%.
[*]Ground acceleration increased by 25%.
[*]Flight, initial jump increased by 15%.
[*]Falling, allow Yuri to keep falling through glass platforms when Jetpack is off, by pressing down.[/list]

notes.title: AWESOMENAUTS 4.2 - OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/c6427cfa411bf19c5a69138c86a74b0d274860ae.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! is available NOW on Steam! A new character, new portraits, and a huge amount of improvements! Play now and take out Smiles for a spin! If you already own the All Nauts Pack, Smiles will be automatically unlocked for you!

Don't have the All Nauts pack yet? No worries! You can also unlock him with Awesomepoints if you've been saving up!

The latest update is the second one we're releasing this summer and there's a lot more coming up! Stay tuned for more news about awesome content launching beyond Update 4.2!

In addition to Smiles joining the Awesomenauts, we're also releasing a pretty awesome skin for him. Check out Pyromancer Smiles! http://store.steampowered.com/app/497621
Catch the full patch notes below!

[h1][b]Update 4.2[/b][/h1]
12-7-2017

[b]NEW Naut: Smiles[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i]
[list][*]Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
[*]Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel stail, knocking them away.
[*]Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.[/list]

[i]Short backstory:[/i]
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

[b]NEW skin: Pyromancer Smiles[/b]
Some crocodiles just want to watch the world burn. Pyromancer Smiles won't settle for that. He has peered into the flames and had visions of him setting all of creation ablaze! He's left the (now scorched) swamps of Ribbit II on a quest to fulfill this dark destiny, and stowed away on the Awesomenauts vessel to visit distant worlds. What's left standing after a battle is incinerated by the Pyromancer, until only ash remains.

He's dark, he's angry, and he's armed with a flamethrower. Don't cross Pyromancer Smiles as he'll burn you to a crisp! The Flames command it!

[b]NEW: added portraits[/b][list][*]Fire commander
[*]Ice commander
[*]Love commander
[*]Team power
[*]The collection
[*]Hairy King[/list]

[b]General[/b][list][*]The scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
[*]Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
[*]Fixed that sometimes after closing the Steam overlay and pressing enter to chat, it would register as a shift+enter instead, opening all chat instead of team chat.
[*]Fixed that if you moved the mouse very close to the centre of Coco and used her AA, her arms would extend in a different direction than her attack.
[*]There is a new, more streamlined tutorial flow for new players.
[*]Fixed that running on 1280x1024 or using the Screen Adjustment feature would cut off parts of the in-game HUD.
[*]Steam IDs are no longer logged while in character select, fixing that players could figure out who they were going to play against before the match actually started.
[*]Fixed that practice games could be joined via chat, for a short period.
[*]Fixed that banned players wouldn’t get a ‘cancelled’ notification when trying to queue[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b][list][*]Fixed that (some) counters for achievements would not update for some players.
[*]Fixed that the Slowwolf announcer would not be granted to a player that got the “Welcome back!” achievement in a beta.[/list]

[b]Menus[/b][list][*]Fixed that League 1 didn't exist for some older seasons in the leaderboad history.
[*]Depth issue fix for character icons in menus on Mac.
[*]Fixed that it was possible to get stuck in a state where all buttons in the Play menu are locked after trying to join a custom game of which the last slot was just taken by another player.
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking multiple times on a character profile picture in a lobby would result in an endless growing tooltip.
[*]The tooltip about the items that you can buy now correctly states level 3 instead of level 4 at which you have unlocked all items.[/list]

[b]Sound[/b][list][*]Optimised all sounds to use less space on disk and in memory and to load a bit quicker.
[*]The “test voice” button in the Armory now correctly plays voice lines of premium skins.
[*]Announcer voices and player-triggered character voices are now better audible.[/list]

[b]Bots[/b][list][*]Updated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots[/list]

[b]Modding[/b][list][*]Added a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. It is also possible to play local versus this way if only one of the local players switches team. This is an experimental feature that probably has a lot of issues, use at your own risk. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.
[*]Added an option to Button to only react to a specific character class.
[*]Added automatic backup to the map editor (once every two minutes and when exiting the editing session).
[*]Added an option to the AIDebugger (the F4 editor) to view detailed events about character gameplay. There is also an option to filter these events and to show them only for the selected character.
[*]Fixed a crash when using the WriteToTextbox AI block in combination with zero respawn time or switchClass/switchTeam.
[*]Fixed that actions and conditions weren’t sorted alphabetically in the BehaviourCreator tool.
[*]Fixed that AffectAreas, JumpPads and Shops didn’t become invisible in the editor when the “Gameplay objects” group was hidden.[/list]

[b]Thanks[/b]
For almost all of our updates since launch we’ve received extensive help from the community to discuss and point out balance issues and bugs. As always, we’re grateful for your input and we would hereby like to start highlighting community members for their efforts.

For this update in particular we say thanks to community members Gameinsky, Doppelganger, Sam! And Wakkabanana for their input, active Discord presence and willingness to provide input upon a wide range of balance topics.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]

Also, fix a bug where 0 and 1 enemy target added the same amount of shielding.[/i][list][*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 15%>15%>20%>25%>30% to 7%>14%>21%>28%>35%

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! Launches July 12th!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9f8c73f6f85e9820436ef89fd97b79e31d138a5d.png[/img]If you didn't catch the Streamisho yesterday, you might have missed the news that Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! will launch on July 12th! Rejoice!

The new update will contain Smiles, the flamethrower-wielding Renegade, an awesome Pyromancer Smiles skin, and some sweet new portraits! If you want to catch all the details, you can rewatch the full Streamisho on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=82GSJHJUXqI[h1]PYROMANCER SMILES[/h1]
Some crocodiles just want to watch the world burn. Pyromancer Smiles won't settle for that. He won't stop until all of creation is set ablaze! He's dark, he's angry, and he's armed with a flamethrower. Don't cross Pyromancer Smiles as he'll burn you to a crisp!

The Pyromancer Smiles skin will come with unique voicelines and gives an ever darker twist to the angriest Renegade of the bunch! The skin will be available when Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! launches next week![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9c2721c13ced869516060b3f49952437ff50f5f3.png[/img]
[H1]NEW MEDALS[/H1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/3ff09e93e7bde68020a330f9b0292835e7d9dc84.jpg[/img]
With so many community events recently, we're adding in-game medals for accomplishments in these events in Update 4.2! How you earn them is up to the tournament hosts (with some limitations), so keep your eyes peeled for new community events in the coming weeks to learn more about how to earn these!

Are you hosting an event and want to give these away to particants? Get in touch with us through robin@ronimo-games.com!
[H1]NEW PROFILE PORTRAITS[/H1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d7da457e6727ae6c5a7f8e32770f224733a4ee1f.jpg[/img]
We're also adding a couple of sweet new portraits to the game with this update. We'll be revealing them in the week ahead, but you can already get a sneak peak at a new Giga Sentorii portrait above!
[H1]ROOKIE ROYALE[/H1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/aac2548bc6aed718be1560c8f0eaf1ccd373094d.png[/img]
The Rookie Royale came to a close last weekend, and it's been a great event overall. Thanks to all players who participated, were involved in coaching new players, made the event happen, and helped out with the on the shows! You guys are the best!

The Rookie Royale was an accessible tournament for players with little to no experience in the competitive community, where experienced players could coach them. We've seen a lot of new players compete, as well as many familiar faces from the community, and it's a blast overall!

Specifically, thanks to Alexeus, Slevens, Erabosu, Devmon, Uberransy, Body_Hunter, Skner, Pixelhat, Pasha, all the coaches, and everyone else who helped out behind the scenes!

Stay tuned for more events from the Awesomenauts League Project in the coming weeks.
[H1]KING OF THE FROGS[/H1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9a6549e4fd4bcad0cd26a8cdba333249ddc8eadf.jpg[/img]
Bets hosted a drop-in/drop-out King of the Frogs event right after the Streamisho, as a follow-up to the previous round of KotF two weeks back. Rather than go head-to-head as Froggy G, players faced off as Dizzy this week.

[H1]ART CONTEST BY REXIC[/h1]
Community member Rexic hosted an art contest on the forums this week, challenging community artists to make summer-themed artwork based on Awesomenauts, with cash money as the prize! Thanks to Rexic for hosting this, because the submissions are AWESOME!

Lowgrasswhite won with an adorable piece of artwork featuring Coco and Nibbs, and it's just fantastic. Catch it below![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/415113fa5059cc4ac53cb43295e3026ee86df615.png[/img]
If you want to check out all submissions, head over to the official Awesomenauts forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=12&t=50518
