notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2 - Fired Up! Open Beta Updated
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/b910166728c576bfba14aedc7c40507957bbed74.png[/img]We just updated the Open Beta for Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! on Steam! Jump into the open beta to try out a whole bunch of tweaks to the new character, Smiles, as well as further experimental changes to Derpl, Yuri, and Ted McPain!

Full patch notes are below![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/40bae42027a5c5ec0b961aa7174f3a7fcc2ad1bf.png[/img]
As always, please be aware that all changes in this open beta are subject to change, and your feedback plays an important role in helping to decide what makes it into the game and what needs further tuning.

Specifically the changes to Yuri, Derpl, and Ted McPain are currently subject to change and will likely return for further tweaks in betas for later updates.

For info on how to access the open beta, [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487&p=274059#p274059]please visit our official forums[/url].

[h1][b]Update 4.2 Beta 2[/b][/h1]
28-6-2017

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that (some) counters for achievements would not update for some players.
[*]Fixed that the Slowwolf announcer would not be granted to a player that got the “Welcome back!” achievement in a beta.
[*]Fixed that the “Dinosaurs don’t like brain boxes” achievement would be granted if a player makes a kill after rejoining.
[*]Made the sound ducking on announcer voices and player-triggered character voices more subtle.
[*]Fixed that if you moved the mouse very close to the centre of Coco and used her AA, her arms would extend in a different direction than her attack.
[*]Optimised all sounds to use less space on disk and in memory and to load a bit quicker.[/list]

[b]Modding[/b][list]
[*]Added an option to Button objects to only react to a specific character class.
[*]Added an option to the AIDebugger (the F4 editor) to view detailed events about character gameplay. There is also an option to filter these events and to show them only for the selected character.
[*]Fixed a crash when using the WriteToTextbox AI block in combination with zero respawn time or switchClass/switchTeam.
[*]Fixed that actions and conditions weren’t sorted alphabetically in the BehaviourCreator tool.
[*]Fixed that AffectAreas, JumpPads and Shops didn’t become invisible in the editor when the “Gameplay objects” group was hidden.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b][list]
[*]Rip-Apart Bear upgrade, self damage reduction increased from 18% to 25%.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b][list]
[*]Gave Derpl’s cats a moving tail for a better visual effect and feel.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b][list]
[*]Prismatic Moonstone Dust upgrade, damage over time reduced from 110 to 90 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b][list]
[*]Bush Fire, damage against turrets reduced from 32 to 25 per flame.
[*]Bush Fire, damage against droids increased from 21 to 25 per flame.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, duration increased from 0.8s to 1.1s.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, reeling in now takes 0.5s instead of 0.1s.
[*]Tail Whip, added 0.2s of stun.
[*]Unicornian Butt upgrade, stun increase reduced from 0.5s to 0.3s.
[*]Warbot Heart upgrade, now also heals for 90.
[*]Snapper Trap upgrade, price reduced from 215 to 175.
[*]Snapper Trap upgrade, now heals for 250 upon landing Trapper’s Hook.
[*]Candy Rope upgrade, now weakens affected enemies during the Hook for 20% for 160 solar.
[*]My First Machete upgrade, slow increased from 10% to 12% per stage, duration increased from 1s to 2s, price increased from 145 to 160 per stage.
[*]Inscribed Lighter upgrade, lifetime of flames increased from 1.3s to 2s, time between damage reduced to 0.4s.
[*]Renegade walky talky upgrade, now shortens teleport to 1.5s when allies are near.[/list]

[h1][b]Highly Experimental, long term iterations[/b][/h1]

[i]The changes listed below are experiments for you all to play around with and tell us what you think. Unless there’s a majority or proponents reached, these changes won’t make it into the upcoming update. The idea is for us to iterate upon these ideas until they might one day make it into the game.[/i]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]Did some tweaks since last beta, trying to make tapping the trap button stick closer to the original behaviour. The trap now only flies out when fully charged[/i][list]
[*]Grid Trap, if the skill isn’t fully charged, the Trap will be place at Derpl’s position.
[*]Grid Trap, reduced the distance covered by fully charged Trap by 50%.
[*]Fatcat upgrade, no longer affected by Longcat.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b]
[i]A lot of players shun shotgun because it’s a bit clunky and the high-cooldown, high-damage aspect is easier to mess op than the continuous stream from machinegun. This experiment tries to make him play a bit smoother, stimulating more players to switch weapons more frequently. Last beta the damage wasn’t actually nerfed to compensate, these changes should bring the values more toward the original Ted.[/i][list]
[*]Shotgun attack speed decreased from last beta by 20%.
[*]Shotgun damage reduced by 20%.[/list]
[i]Changed Stimpack and upgrades to fit with the changes above.[/i][list]
[*]Stim pack attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 40%.
[*]Ammo weekly attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 12% per stage.
[*]Ted McPain Unicorn Dance Karting upgrade, damage per stage increased from 47 to 67.
[*]Ted’s Power Briefs upgrade, shotgun knockback increase increased from 240% to 340%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b]
[i]Iterating upon the ideas from the last beta, trying to remove old restrictions to make Yuri play a bit smoother while making it possible for veterans to keep their style. Additionally trying to add more depth through the charges mechanic of his laser.[/i][list]
[*]Flight, initial jump increased by 30%.
[*]Falling, allow Yuri to keep falling through glass platforms when Jetpack is off, by pressing down.
[*]Ground acceleration and speed increased by 30%.
[*]Laser, time between damage stages reduced from 1.2 to 0.7 seconds.
[*]Laser, 3rd stage added to base, each stage adds 8 damage per tick.
[*]Mine deploying, now limited to 2 mines. Creating a 3rd make the oldest explode.
[*]Mine deploying, lifetime increased from 8 to 12 seconds.
[*]Mine deploying, a hit indicator lets the Yuri player know if someone was hit by a mine.
[*]Giant Monocle upgrade, range increase now starts at 10%, every damage stage adds 10%.
[*]Resonance Amplifier upgrade, now adds 1 charge level, adding 8 damage.
[*]Hubble’s Lens upgrade, now locks Yuri in place while firing and reduces time between charges from 0.7s to 0.3s.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired up! - Out in Beta now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7faad9f9b8b87da0bc007c8da7db8716b697ea84.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired up! is now live in the Open Beta for Awesomenauts! This update contains a lot of character updates, a new feature for the level editor, and a brand new playable character!
 
Meet Smiles, a crocodile with his trapping hook and a tail to run away from! Are you ready for something extra crispy? Then you definitely want to try out his flamethrower![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/40bae42027a5c5ec0b961aa7174f3a7fcc2ad1bf.png[/img]To access the Beta for Update 4.2: Fired up! follow the steps below: [list]
[*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
[*]Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta access DLC" is checked.
[*]Select the "Beta" tab and switch to "beta - public channel".
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"[/list]This update also contains balance updates for several characters. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.2.
 
Please share your feedback on the Beta forum here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

[h1]Update 4.2 Beta 1[/h1]
21-6-2017

[b]NEW Naut: Smiles[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i]
Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel tail, knocking them away.
Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.

[i]Short backstory:[/i]
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]The scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
[*]Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
[*]Fixed that sometimes when you had the steam overlay open and pressing enter, it would register as a shift+enter instead.[/list]
 
[b]Bots[/b][list]
[*]Updated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots.[/list]
 
[b]Modding[/b][list]
[*]Added a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. It is also possible to play local versus this way if only one of the local players switches team. This is an experimental feature that probably has a lot of issues, use at your own risk. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Make it harder for Ayla to endlessly chase a single enemy in Rage mode, while keeping her teamfighting ability about the same.[/i][list]
[*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 15%>20%>25%>30% to 9%>18%>27%>36%
[*]Rage, self damage increased from 33 to 40.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.[/list]
[i]Boost Ayla’s earlygame, and reduce her reliance on Angry Drawings[/i][list]
[*]Rage, base DPS increased from 252 to 276.
[*]Angry Drawings upgrade, damage increase reduced from 17% to 11%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Chucho Krokk[/b][list]
[*]One Armed Chameleon upgrade, bonus damage reduced from 90 to 85.
[*]Nitro Muffler upgrade, damage over time reduced from 180 to 170 per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b][list]
[*]Iron Slam, the hud icon now indicates which punch will be next.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b][list]
[*]Torn D-Shirt upgrade, now only affects Awesomenauts.
[*]Golden G Necklace upgrade, targets hit by Explosive Clone take 15% increased damage for 3 seconds.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b][list]
[i]Changes to make Frog a bit more safe while also reducing all or nothing potency with landing his whirlwind.[/i]
[*]Base health increased from 1150 to 1200.
[*]Dash, base damage increased from 250 to 280.
[*]Ice Cubes upgrade, slow per stage reduced from 15% to 12%, price reduced from 150 to 140.
[*]Clock Necklace upgrade, heal over time reduced from 140 to 120.
[*]Boombox upgrade, damage increase reduced from 16% to 13% per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list]
[*]Baby Kuri Mammoth now affects cocoon.
[*]Butterfly shot, fixed that returning projectile now also does 65 at base.
[*]Wool Shawl upgrade, range increase reduced from 40% to 30%.
[*]Caterpillar King statue upgrade, heal reduced from 20 to 18.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list]
[*]Feather Ball upgrade, now adds a 3rd spit projectile.
[*]Fertilizer upgrade, now increases Weedling health by 20% and health regeneration by 50%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix the Interloper[/b][list]
[*]Salt Miner upgrade, damage per tick reduced from 18 to 16 per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list]
[*]Micey the Mech Pilot upgrade, price increased from 125 to 150 solar.

[*]Steel False Teeth upgrade, now gives Leon a shield that reduces 20% of incoming damage for 2 seconds when successfully landing tongue.[/list]

[b]Max Focus[/b][list]
[*]Galactic Police Scanner upgrade, damage increase reduced from 30% to 27%, price increased from 155 to 180.

[*]Hairy King upgrade, size increased reduced from +15% to +10%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Nibbs_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list]
[*]Red Sneakers upgrade, price reduced from 155 to 140, speed increase increased from 5% to 8%.
[*]Sunscreen Mouthwash upgrade, speed increase reduced from 100% to 75%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list]
[*]Sentient Rock upgrade, silence duration reduced from 0.3s to 0.25s per charge.
[*]Chicken in a Lunch Box upgrade, amplified damage increase reduced from 15% to 12%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list]
[*]Base attack, speed penalty for shooting reduced by 25%.[/list]
    
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b][list]
[*]Cockfight Spurs upgrade, price reduced from 200 to 180 solar per stage.
[*]Chicken Grill upgrade, price reduced from 185 to 175 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list]
[*]Base movement, speed and acceleration increase by 5%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, cooldown increased from 10s to 11s.
[*]Bug Detector upgrade, now deals 200 damage over 4s when the shield hits an enemy.
[*]Night Vision Spywatch upgrade, movement speed increase reduced from 50% to 30%.
[*]Circuits of time upgrade, now requires 0.6s arming time before the clone explodes.
[*]Not-So-Serious Tank upgrade, damage increase increased from 12% to 14%.
[*]Hacking Satellite upgrade, merged into single stage upgrade, reduces cooldown by 3s for 200 solar.
[*]Cyanide Cigarettes upgrade, price reduced from 185 to 170 solar per stage.
[*]Yellow King Pages upgrade, price reduced from 205 to 190 solar per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list]
[*]Magic Sunballs upgrade, extra targets reduced from 3 to 2, price reduced from 250 to 220.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Admiral_Swiggins_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Swiggins[/b][list]
[*]Ancient Octants upgrade, stun no longer applies to the whole area.
[*]Pneumatic Spoon upgrade, break damage increase reduced from 100 to 90 per stage.
[*]Bovinian Skimmed Milk upgrade, damage amplification reduced from 15% to 12%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b][list]
[*]Shotgun attack speed increased by 42%.
[*]Shotgun damage reduced by 42%.
[*]Removed the slowdown penalty on shooting with shotgun.
[*]Stim pack attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 40%.
[*]Ammo weekly attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 12% per stage.
[*]Commando Ted Figurine upgrade, damage increase reduced from 17 to 13% per stage for Machine gun, 13% to 11% for shotgun.
[*]Ted McPain Unicorn Dance Karting upgrade, damage per stage reduced from 80 to 47.
[*]Ted’s Power Briefs upgrade, shotgun knockback increase reduced from 400% to 240%.[/list]
 
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Vinnie_&_Spike_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Vinnie & Spike[/b][list]
[*]Antique Machinegun upgrade, silence duration reduced from 1.5s to 1s.
[*]Yakoiza upgrade, extra damage reduced from 71% to 62%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Voltar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Voltar[/b][list]
[*]Bombshell upgrade, damage reduced from 300 to 280, price increased from 130 to 150 per stage.
[*]Warpgate Overdrive upgrade, cooldown reduction increased from -1.5s to -1s.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b]
[i]Iterating upon the ideas from the last beta, to Yuri play more smoothly and reworking his laser row, while this time maintaining the possibility of playing him in the same way current players are used to.[/i][list]
[*]Flight, acceleration increased by 33%.
[*]Flight, maximum vertical speed increased by 10%.
[*]Laser, time between damage stages increased from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds.
[*]Laser, firing it now reduces movement speed by 60%, instead of locking Yuri in place.
[*]Mine deploying, lifetime reduced from 10 to 8 seconds.
[*]Baby Yeti upgrade, slow now starts at 10%, every damage stage adds 5%.
[*]Resonance Amplifier upgrade, now adds 1 charge level per stage, each adding +10 damage.
[*]Hubble’s Lens upgrade, now locks Yuri in place while firing and reduces time between charges from 1.5s to 0.3s.
[*]Toaster Timer upgrade, now makes Mines detonate on second press, also increases explosion size by 25%.
[*]Aerial Spring upgrade, now lets Yuri throw his mines instead of dropping them.
[*]Chrono Rift, price reduced from 190 to 140 solar.[/list]

[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"[/list]This update also contains balance updates for several characters. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.2.
 
Please share your feedback on the Beta forum here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

[h1]Update 4.2 Beta 1[/h1]
21-6-2017

[b]NEW Naut: Smiles[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i]
Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel tail, knocking them away.
Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.

[i]Short backstory:[/i]
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]The scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
[*]Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
[*]Fixed that sometimes when you had the steam overlay open and pressing enter, it would register as a shift+enter instead.[/list]
 
[b]Bots[/b][list]
[*]Updated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots.[/list]
 
[b]Modding[/b][list]
[*]Added a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. It is also possible to play local versus this way if only one of the local players switches team. This is an experimental feature that probably has a lot of issues, use at your own risk. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Make it harder for Ayla to endlessly chase a single enemy in Rage mode, while keeping her teamfighting ability about the same.[/i][list]
[*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 15%>20%>25%>30% to 9%>18%>27%>36%
[*]Rage, self damage increased from 33 to 40.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.[/list]
[i]Boost Ayla’s earlygame, and reduce her reliance on Angry Drawings[/i][list]
[*]Rage, base DPS increased from 252 to 276.
[*]Angry Drawings upgrade, damage increase reduced from 17% to 11%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Chucho Krokk[/b][list]
[*]One Armed Chameleon upgrade, bonus damage reduced from 90 to 85.
[*]Nitro Muffler upgrade, damage over time reduced from 180 to 170 per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b][list]
[*]Iron Slam, the hud icon now indicates which punch will be next.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b][list]
[*]Torn D-Shirt upgrade, now only affects Awesomenauts.
[*]Golden G Necklace upgrade, targets hit by Explosive Clone take 15% increased damage for 3 seconds.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b][list]
[i]Changes to make Frog a bit more safe while also reducing all or nothing potency with landing his whirlwind.[/i]
[*]Base health increased from 1150 to 1200.
[*]Dash, base damage increased from 250 to 280.
[*]Ice Cubes upgrade, slow per stage reduced from 15% to 12%, price reduced from 150 to 140.
[*]Clock Necklace upgrade, heal over time reduced from 140 to 120.
[*]Boombox upgrade, damage increase reduced from 16% to 13% per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list]
[*]Baby Kuri Mammoth now affects cocoon.
[*]Butterfly shot, fixed that returning projectile now also does 65 at base.
[*]Wool Shawl upgrade, range increase reduced from 40% to 30%.
[*]Caterpillar King statue upgrade, heal reduced from 20 to 18.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list]
[*]Feather Ball upgrade, now adds a 3rd spit projectile.
[*]Fertilizer upgrade, now increases Weedling health by 20% and health regeneration by 50%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix the Interloper[/b][list]
[*]Salt Miner upgrade, damage per tick reduced from 18 to 16 per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list]

[*]Micey and the Missile Factory upgrade, price reduced from 215 to 200 solar.

[b]Leon[/b][list]

[b]Nibbs[/b][list]

[b]Sentry[/b][list]

[b]Skree[/b][list]

[b]Ted McPain[/b][list]
[*]Shotgun attack speed increased by 42%.
[*]Shotgun damage reduced by 42%.
[*]Removed the slowdown penalty on shooting with shotgun.
[*]Stim pack attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 40%.
[*]Ammo weekly attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 12% per stage.
[*]Commando Ted Figurine upgrade, damage increase reduced from 17 to 13% per stage for Machine gun, 13% to 11% for shotgun.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Vinnie_&_Spike_001.jpg[/img]

[*]Yakoiza upgrade, extra damage reduced from 71% to 62%.[/list]

[b]Voltar[/b][list]
[*]Bombshell upgrade, damage reduced from 300 to 280, price increased from 130 to 150 per stage.
[*]Warpgate Overdrive upgrade, cooldown reduction increased from -1.5s to -1s.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]

[*]Flight, acceleration increased by 33%.
[*]Flight, maximum vertical speed increased by 10%.
[*]Laser, time between damage stages increased from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds.
[*]Laser, firing it now reduces movement speed by 60%, instead of locking Yuri in place.
[*]Mine deploying, lifetime reduced from 10 to 8 seconds.
[*]Baby Yeti upgrade, slow now starts at 10%, every damage stage adds 5%.
[*]Resonance Amplifier upgrade, now adds 1 charge level per stage, each adding +10 damage.
[*]Hubble’s Lens upgrade, now locks Yuri in place while firing and reduces time between charges from 1.5s to 0.3s.
[*]Toaster Timer upgrade, now makes Mines detonate on second press, also increases explosion size by 25%.
[*]Aerial Spring upgrade, now lets Yuri throw his mines instead of dropping them.
[*]Chrono Rift, price reduced from 190 to 140 solar.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.1 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d80afb2ae94c4bf169912230d17dc62231f8cc86.png[/img]
While everyone at E3 is focused on games shipping later this year or even in 2018, we're bringing you great new content TODAY! Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades is available on Steam now! The best part is: everyone can enjoy Awesomenauts completely for free! This patch introduces a new character, brings additional gameplay improvements, adds additional level editor functionality, and much more!
 
Rocket’s Renegades are a group of mercenaries on the run from injustice, but they’re out for revenge! Dizzy is the first of them to join the Awesomenauts in this update. Commander Rocket, Smiles, and Qi’Tara will be joining in updates later this summer! Here is the trailer introducing all four of the Renegades: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw  
Dizzy is a swift character that has the ability to dash multiple times. She can also leave a water-clone that explodes and hits all foes in the vicinity! Dizzy can be bought with Awesomepoints or will be available instantly for All Nauts Pack-owners.
 
[h1]Two new skins![/h1]

[h1]Bullbarian Deadlift[/h1]
The long awaited skin for this Bovinion is now here! Meet the brutal Bullbarian Deadlift! Show off your greatsword when playing on the red team and an astonishing axe when playing on the blue team!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2aa7bc0c429e3ed53cab349924fc10ad11e3d990.png[/img]http://store.steampowered.com/app/557003[h1]Kunoichi Dizzy[/h1]
After three gruelling years in the Waxxon Spiral, Dizzy completed her Aqua-Fu training. She had become Kunoichi Dizzy, Master of the Aqua-Fu!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/fec69d8061496b194d557f3f8db3233e318a554f.png[/img]http://store.steampowered.com/app/634010/Awesomenauts__Kunoichi_Dizzy_Skin/
[h1]Switching classes[/h1]
Mod creators are now able to use mechanics that switch you to other‘Nauts and skins in custom maps. It is even possible to play as a creep or droid, if you want! This gives new options for creative game modes, and we can’t wait to see what crazy stuff our community members will make! Check out this small video about the feature. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xigvHbNIy7M
[h1]New medals[/h1]
We’re also adding a new series of in-game medals for players who manage to attain over 250 wins with a character! These are meant to show off the accomplishments of some our most dedicated players, who have been part of our community for years.
 
[h1]Looking ahead[/h1]
Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades is just the first update that we’ve got lined up for the summer, and players can look forward to more characters, more unlockables, and more improvements over the coming months! In fact, the next character to join the Awesomenauts will be made available in Open Beta next week already!
 
Get ready to take Smiles to the battlefield soon!
 
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
For the full patch notes on Awesomenauts 4.1, head over to our official forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=2440

notes.title: Reveals, winners, and launch dates!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cc9f8ba1c7e7b835eadfc4f3a158deff824a1858.jpg[/img]We revealed the new Deadlift skin, the launch date of Update 4.1, and announced the honorable mentions for the guide contest on the Streamisho yesterday. You can read all the news below, or check it out on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h6DOKvgZpi4
[h1]Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades launch date[/h1]
After we launched the Beta version for Update 4.1 and Dizzy last week, we 'll be ready to launch Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades one week from now - on the 14th of June! Be sure to tune in to the Streamisho at 17:00 EU, 16:00 UK, 11 AM Easter, 8 AM Pacific over at www.twitch.tv/RonimoGames

[h1]Dazzling Dizzy character theme![/h1]
We listened to the great rapping skills of Dizzy on her character theme reveal. Did you miss it? Check it out here and let us know what you think! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AdbCNr_mL3c 
[h1]Brutal Bullbarian![/h1]
The Bullbarian Deadlift skin was revealed during the Streamisho. Show off your mighty sword when playing on the Red team and an astonishing axe when playing on the Blue team!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2aa7bc0c429e3ed53cab349924fc10ad11e3d990.png[/img]
[h1]Guide contest winners[/h1]
A lot of great guides were written for the guide contest and we want to thank all participants for their efforts! The winners were announced live, and you can find all the guides in the announcement below.
http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1271551821052096819
[h1]Community news[/h1]
 
[h1]Awesomenauts Rumble: June Gathers[/h1]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0.6 - Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6a68cd2167999fddccab5703a4526254c31fee54.png[/img]We just released a hotfix for Awesomenauts that addresses a couple of issues players have encountered over the last week. This includes fixes for the issue where players would be stuck in the queue at 0:00, the SlowWolf announcer not unlocking as intended, and other connectivity issues.

Catch the patch notes below for the full details on the issues that have been addressed. Please continue to let us know if you happen to run into  problems over on the official tech support forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=13

[h1]Update 4.0.6[/h1]
1-6-2017
 
[b]General[/b][list][*]Fixed a bug that caused players to get stuck in the matchmaker queue at time 0:00
[*]Fixed a bug that caused players get stuck in a party that didn’t allow them to play at all.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the matchmaker to go down altogether in very rare cases.
[*]Fixed that sometimes the Slowwolf announcer would not unlock.
[*]Fixed that for some people, not all prestige medals would be unlocked.
[*]Fixed that sometimes random announcer would result in no announcer at all.
[*]Invite suggestions will only show players who are in global chat.
[*]Fixed that the "Attack of the botanic Army!" achievement often didn't count the Weedlings you placed, and sometimes counted Weedlings you didn't place.
[*]Fixed that the game would reset last selected skins on startup.
[*]On first startup, the game language will now be determined by the language used in steam, instead of always defaulting to English for new users.
[*]To fix the massive recruitment code spam in global chat users can no longer post their recruitment code in global chat. Recruitment codes can still be shared via party or team chat or outside of the game.
[*]Global chat will block users from sending the same message within a short time period.
[*]Fixed the win streak statistic on the stats screen.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Fixed Penny bullets not bouncing off the ceiling[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cc9f8ba1c7e7b835eadfc4f3a158deff824a1858.jpg[/img]
4.0 has been out for just over a week and we already announced Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades on the Streamisho! You can read all the news covered below, or check it out on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zXrubPH8MQ
Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades went live in the Beta version of the game. Meet Commander Rocket, Qi’Tara, Dizzy, and Smiles! You can check the Beta out now and rock with the brand new character: Dizzy!
 
Check out the full announcement and the patch notes here:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1271551639292937239
[h1]Community news[/h1]
 
[h1]Guide contest[/h1]
We announced the winner of the Guide Contest on the Streamisho, and it's Diz Hydron with the "Welcome to Awesomenauts! Everything you need to know to get started!" guide!

Find the guide here and read about all the useful tips and everything you need to know when you are trying out Awesomenauts for the first time. It might also have a lot of useful tips for players who've already got a bunch of matches under their belt though, so it's basically a great read for everyone! http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=918204085 
The honorable mentions will be announced later this week or during next week's Streamisho. Thank you all for participating! Having this information available on Steam helps new and existing players enormously!

[h1]New Level editor features[/h1]
The level editor comes with new features in Update 4.1! You can now switch classes and skins in custom maps. It is even possible to play as a creep or droid, if you want! Check out the short video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xigvHbNIy7M 
[h1]Awesomenauts Rumble: June Gathers[/h1]
The June Gathers tournament is now open for sign-ups. This casual tournament encourages players of every kind to join and get familiar with the competitive scene of Awesomenauts. More info on [url=https://sites.google.com/awesomenautsrumble.com/home/gathers]their website![/url]
 
[h1]ALP: Rookie Royale[/h1]
The Rookie Royale invites new players to join an Awesomenauts tournament. The team will be under supervision of a veteran, who will coach the players during the tournament. The sign-ups will start on the 3rd of June!
 
[h1]ALP: Awesomenauts Console Clash 3[/h1]
The tournament will start this weekend on the 3rd of June and continue on the 4th of June with the finals. There is still time to sign up and join the clash [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdnX_-8Wz4znyCjMdSjea1s1Btl5ExPQwQ-EvDNtDbI39mMug/viewform?c=0&w=1]here[/url]

[h1]Community highlight[/h1]
Wabtfan made a new custom map called Galactron Construct 127. Team iris doors shut when enemies are near; no droids nor Awesomenauts may pass through during this. The iris door remains open at all times after destruction of corresponding turret.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=932299677&utm_content=bufferf07a6&utm_medium=social&utm_source=twitter.com&utm_campaign=buffer

notes.title: Meet Rocket's Renegades - Dizzy now in Beta!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cc9f8ba1c7e7b835eadfc4f3a158deff824a1858.jpg[/img]Meet: Rocket's Renegades! Commander Rocket, Qi'Tara, Smiles, and Dizzy have been on the run for years and are finally ready to face the ghosts that haunt their past... and they're doing that by joining the Awesomenauts!

Learn more about this crew in the trailer below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw Dizzy is the first Renegade to enlist with the Awesomenauts, and she is now available in the open beta for Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades! Her fellow Renegades will join the Awesomenauts in future updates, so stay tuned for more news on that!

To access the Beta for Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades, follow the steps below:[list][*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
[*]Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load" is checked.
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"[/list]

On top of this brand new character, Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades also contains significant reworks for Derpl Zork and Yuri, as well as a huge array of balance changes. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.1

Please share your feedback on the Beta forum over on Awesomenauts.com: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

[h1][b]Update 4.1 Beta 1[/b][/h1]
31-5-2017
 
[b]NEW Naut: Dizzy[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i][list]
[*]Multi Dash: Save up to 3 dashes to unleash unto your enemies.
[*]Explosive Clone: Leave a water clone at your location that explodes and deals damage in an area.
[*]Bubble Shot: Fire a fast-moving bubble that deals damage.[/list]
 
[i]Short backstory:[/i][list]
[*]Using her mastery in Aqua-fu, Dizzy fooled the Scarg prison guards with her water clones and escaped along with her team. After being separated, she went back to her home planet to revitalize her singing career. There she formed a girl band called “the Dizzies” together with her water clones and conquered the Universal Music Charts in no time. A popularity poll showed that one of her clones was more popular than her, causing her to go on a graffiti spraying rampage. After being calmed by her old friends, she joins them into joining the Awesomenauts![/list]
 
[b]General[/b][list]
[*]You can now try out skins in the armory
[*]Added sound to the Solar shower in the testmap (the map where you can try out Nauts).
[*]Tweaked when announcers will count down. For instance, it won’t count down in the test level in the armory anymore.[/list]
 
[b]Map editor[/b][list]
[*]Added two new options to AffectAreas: [i]switchToClass[/i] and [i]switchToSkinIndex[/i]. These allow you to swap which character and skin the player uses. This can even be used to switch to characters that are normally not playable, like droids and creeps. Note that a player can only be switched to a class or skin he or she owns. When switching to a class you don’t own, nothing happens. When switching to a skin you don’t own while you do own the class, you instead switch to the default looks of that Naut.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Quality of life change and changing/buffing unpopular upgrades.[/i][list]
[*]Evil eye can now be shot when using rage. Rage will automatically turn off when using evil eye.
[*]Angry Drawings, reduced price from 250 to 220 solar per stage.
[*]Jail Food, increased damage over time from 105 to 135 per stage.
[*]Jail Food, reduced price from 215 to 200 solar per stage.
[*]Rubberband Ball, changed to a damage over time on the blood trail for 140 damage over 2 seconds.
[*]Rubberband Ball, increased price from 150 to 200 solar.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Clunk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Clunk[/b]
[i]Slight movement speed increase to make it harder to punish him.[/i][list]
[*]Base movement speed increased by 8%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Coco_Nebulon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Coco[/b]
[i]Damage increased of slightly too weak upgrade.[/i][list]
[*]Superconductor, increased damage per homing particle from 13 to 15 damage per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b]
[i]Self knockback removed to allow him to stay in fights after lunging.[/i][list]
[*]Power Lunge, removed self knockback on the impact.
[*]Power Lunge, increased consistency by increasing the collision size by 10% while flying.
[*]Power Lunge, now only ends on collision instead of stopping mid-way when flying for a long time.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]Made placing traps less risky and less frustrating to deal with.[/i][list]
[*]Grid trap, can now be thrown for a short distance. They deploy in place after flying for 0.75 seconds.
[*]Grid trap, lifetime reduced from 11 to 6 seconds.
[*]Strengthened Trap, lifetime increase reduced from 8 to 4 seconds.
[*]Empowered Grid, now speeds up Grid trap flight and deployment time by 50% for 180 Solar.
[*]Deployment Pads, knockback size reduced by 25%.
[*]Deployment Pads, made the knockback visual faster.
[*]Long Cat, now also increases the speed of Cat shot.
[*]Long Cat, reduced range and speed increase from 33% to 28% per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b]
[i]Power reduced as he was quite strong. Problematic upgrade replaced.[/i][list]
[*]Butterfly Shot, base damage reduced from 70 to 65 damage.
[*]Monarch Blessing, base duration reduced from 3 to 2.5 seconds. 
[*]Spiritual Cooking, changed to a 1 second duration increase.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, price reduced from 195 to 155 solar.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b]
[i]Reduced potency of a strong upgrade.[/i][list]
[*]Overcharged Metabolism, amplified damage duration reduced from 4 to 3 seconds.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Reduction of potential survivability.[/i][list]
[*]Crystal Crunch, reduced healing per target from 8 to 6 health per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX50[/b]
[i]Changes intended to make the character a bit more accessible and solid.[/i][list]
[*]Missile barrage can no longer be canceled 
[*]Movement during Missile Barrage is no longer blocked, but reduced by 40% instead.
[*]Charge, tick rate increased by 50%, knockback and damage reduced by 50%.
[*]Charge, movement speed reduced by 10%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sheriff_Lonestar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b]
[i]Increased damage of some weaker upgrades.[/i][list]
[*]Missile, increased damage from 100 to 125.
[*]Another Missile, increased damage from 100 to 125.[/list]

notes.title: Meet Rocket's Renegades - Dizzy now in Beta!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cc9f8ba1c7e7b835eadfc4f3a158deff824a1858.jpg[/img]Meet: Rocket's Renegades! Commander Rocket, Qi'Tara, Smiles, and Dizzy have been on the run for years and are finally ready to face the ghosts that haunt their past... and they're doing that by joining the Awesomenauts!

Learn more about this crew in the trailer below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw Dizzy is the first Renegade to enlist with the Awesomenauts, and she is now available in the open beta for Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades! Her fellow Renegades will join the Awesomenauts in future updates, so stay tuned for more news on that!

To access the Beta for Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades, follow the steps below:[list][*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
[*]Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load" is checked.
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"[/list]

On top of this brand new character, Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades also contains significant reworks for Derpl Zork and Yuri, as well as a huge array of balance changes. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.1

Please share your feedback on the Beta forum over on Awesomenauts.com: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

[h1][b]Update 4.1 Beta 1[/b][/h1]
31-5-2017
 
[b]NEW Naut: Dizzy[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i][list]
[*]Multi Dash: Save up to 3 dashes to unleash unto your enemies.
[*]Explosive Clone: Leave a water clone at your location that explodes and deals damage in an area.
[*]Bubble Shot: Fire a fast-moving bubble that deals damage.[/list]
 
[i]Short backstory:[/i][list]
[*]Using her mastery in Aqua-fu, Dizzy fooled the Scarg prison guards with her water clones and escaped along with her team. After being separated, she went back to her home planet to revitalize her singing career. There she formed a girl band called “the Dizzies” together with her water clones and conquered the Universal Music Charts in no time. A popularity poll showed that one of her clones was more popular than her, causing her to go on a graffiti spraying rampage. After being calmed by her old friends, she joins them into joining the Awesomenauts![/list]
 
[b]General[/b][list]
[*]You can now try out skins in the armory
[*]Added sound to the Solar shower in the testmap (the map where you can try out Nauts).
[*]Tweaked when announcers will count down. For instance, it won’t count down in the test level in the armory anymore.[/list]
 
[b]Map editor[/b][list]
[*]Added two new options to AffectAreas: [i]switchToClass[/i] and [i]switchToSkinIndex[/i]. These allow you to swap which character and skin the player uses. - Mine deploying, lifetime reduced from 10 to 4 seconds.
- Toaster timer, added mine lifetime reduced from 2 to 1.5 seconds per stage.
- Uranium Spikes, now reduces hit enemy damage by 10% per stage for 3 seconds, for 135 Solar.

- Cortex Tank, knockback size reduced by 25%.
- Cortex Tank, made the knockback visual faster.

notes.title: Teasers, updates, and new tournaments!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png[/img]
Yesterday marked the last Streamisho before Awesomenauts goes Free-to-Play! The launch of Awesomenauts 4.0 will be on May 24th and a lot of news was announced before the big release. We will cover the news below, but you can watch the VOD here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uwhZSp7-_G8
[h1]Update 4.0.3[/h1] 
In this update, which launched earlier this week, we improved the scoreboard based on community feedback and we will continue to iterate further to make it even more awesome!

Ammo bars were added for characters that use ammo-mechanics and the new visual help notifications for skills can be enabled/disabled in the settings. Check out the full patch notes here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=49979 

[h1]Reddit AMA[/h1]
We will be doing a Reddit AMA today (May 18th) at 17:00 EU (the same time as the start of the Streamisho). Here is the countdown timer, if you're not sure about when to tune in: http://buff.ly/2qrgaHC

The AMA can be found on: https://www.reddit.com/r/IAmA/
Have your burning questions ready!

[h1]New ‘Naut[/h1]
An old newspaper was flying around in space and the readers discovered that a group of space mercenaries escaped from prison on Carcaco back in 3584! The new ‘Naut joining the game in Update 4.1 might have something to do with their breakout![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6f387a6c6ff7bd82ff897bd34643a83cd5073ea6.png[/img]
[h1]Community news[/h1]

[h1]ALP[/h1]
The Awesomenauts League Project announced that there will be 3 events coming soon! Rookie Royale, Console Clash, and The Showcase were all announced during the stream. The sign-ups for the Console Clash and the Rookie Royale will start May 20th and May 24th respectively.

Check out this forum post for updated information on the announced tourrnaments:
http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=47140&start=20 

[h1]Awesomenauts Rumble[/h1]
The Awesomenauts Rumble: Gathers May edition will kick-off on the 20th of May with the Qualifiers and the Playoffs are live on May 21st! Both streams will start 12PM EDT on www.twitch.tv/awesomenautsrumble 

[h1]Workshop highlight[/h1]
In Squadnauts! by CationF, every player will spawn with the same ‘Nauts following them (Lonestars spawn Lonestars, Clunks spawn Clunks, etc).
They have a special custom AI and will follow you wherever you go, meaning you can have huge battles with lots of characters on screen!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=921941322

notes.title: Update 4.0.4 - Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/65518697327da94de7137c81c14b30ce65adb1c4.png[/img]
We just released update 4.0.4, an important update that helps us prepare our servers for the free-to-play launch on May 24th! This update contains some complex new features for our matchmaking system, though if everything works as intended you likely won't notice anything has changed.

We'll continue to monitor the performance of these systems over the coming days!

Full patch notes for this update are included below:

[h1][b]Update 4.0.4[/b][/h1]
18-5-2017

[LIST][*]Made changes so that our servers can handle much larger numbers of simultaneous players once we go free to play. This contains some rather complicated tech so we expect we’ll be doing further fixes to this in the coming days.
[*]Slightly increased the in-game scoreboard size.
[*]Items bought icons are now always shown in the scoreboard when your account level is 6 or higher.
[*]Fixed that you would sometimes still get invite suggestions when your party was already full.
[*]Fixed that poor connection popup would appear partially behind other menus.
[*]Fixed a rare crash while waiting for matchmaking.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Coco_Nebulon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Coco[/b]
[LIST][*]-Fixed that Coco’s Ball Lightning visual was upside down when aiming to the left.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b][LIST][*]-Fixed that Derpl’s Nuke visual was upside down when aiming to the left.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0.3 - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/65518697327da94de7137c81c14b30ce65adb1c4.png[/img]We just released update Awesomenauts 4.0.3, containing a brand-new droppod, tweaks to the in-game scoreboard, and tweaked match rewards!

Additionally, the launcher has been overhauled and should now only show once for all users on Mac and Windows! There are a lot of small tweaks that all polish up the experience, so check out the full patch notes below!

[h1][b]Update 4.0.3[/b][/h1]
16-5-2017

[b]NEW: Zork Industries Mark II “Falling Closet” Droppod[/b]
[list][*]This new droppod has been added to the Armory and is automatically unlocked for free for anyone that has played Awesomenauts before the free to play announcement (april 26th, 2017).[/list]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/605951
[b]Scoreboard[/b]
[list][*]The scoreboard layout has been overhauled. The new layout is more similar to the pre 4 iteration of the scoreboard.
[*]Profile portraits are no longer displayed next to each entry, but on the medal tooltip.
[*]Medals in the scoreboard now display the profile tooltip when hovered over
[*]The end of game scoreboard now includes XP contribution.[/list]
[b]NEW: ‘Skill Help’ option[/b][list]
[*]Added the “Skill Help” setting in General Settings, which enables helpful visual indicators during gameplay for the following skills: Raelynn’s Snipe, Coco’s Ball Lighting, Derpl’s Nuke, Swiggins’ Anchor Drop, Sentry’s Teleport Beacon, Nibbs’ Orb of Omnicron, Ix’s Psionic Bond and Skree’s Saw Blade. This is enabled by default.[/list]
[b]Launcher[/b][list]
[*]The launcher has been visually overhauled (Windows and Mac only).
[*]The launcher is now only shown the first time you start the game, or if you didn’t get into gameplay (since this may indicate a screen issue that requires the launcher to fix).[/list]
[b]Tweaked XP and Awesomepoints rewards[/b][list]
[*]XP and Awesomepoints rewards have been tweaked. Any previously received rewards have not been changed. The average Awesomepoints and XP gain per minute played has not changed for Online Match but has been significantly lowered for very short Co-op vs Bots matches.
[*]The minimum length for a match to yield rewards has been lowered from 3 to 1 minute.
[*]Awesomepoints and XP are now always gained per minute, with the first 4 minutes accumulating more points (even more if you win). This replaces the old large fixed amount + an amount that would accumulate over time beyond the 11 minute mark.
[*]This new way of accumulating points now makes winning very short matches of Co-op vs Bots way less effective as it used to be and winning short Online Matches slightly less effective. Co-op vs Bots should now always be on par or slightly behind Online Match in terms of XP and Awesomepoints gain.
[*]Depending on the duration of the match some matches might now yield more or less points than they used to. Generally, point accumulation has been smoothened out. Short matches (below 8 minutes) typically yield less to slightly less points. Average matches yield slightly more, and very long matches (30+ minutes) yield very slightly less.
[*]The first win of the day bonus now always yields the same amount of points, when achieved.[/list]
[b]Tutorial[/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where in the training match a big stack of droids could be formed, if players stayed at the shop for too long.
[*]Fixed that sometimes in the training match the other lane would be pushed entirely while the player wasn’t there.[/list]
[b]General[/b][list]
[*]Shielded damage is now hidden by default (there is a setting in General Settings to re-enable it). For example, 40 damage being reduced to 32 would previously show as “32🛡8” and will now show as “32🛡”, unless you re-enable the new option.
[*]Mute/report menu now displays players’ chosen characters instead of their profile portrait.
[*]Fixed that music after the first droppod sequence at the start of a match started too early (the first beat should coincide with the opening of the door).
[*]Fixed a rare crash when a character died.
[*]Fixed a crash when closing the game.
[*]Fixed a rare crash that happened during the victory animation.
[*]Fixed a crash when launching the game while Steam is not running.
[*]Fixed a rare crash when uploading a replay fails.
[*]Fixed that a small number was sometimes shown over the player character, in the middle of the screen during gameplay.
[*]Fixed a rare issue where new players would not be able to start the tutorial (or any other mode) and would see an empty party in the main menu.
[*]Added some decorations to the test map (where you can try Nauts from the Armory).[/list]
[b]Menus[/b][list]
[*]Fixed various glitches after playing the intro video, including the tutorial popup endlessly returning.
[*]Fixed an issue with the text flipping out when the checkbox to hide the incognito popup was selected.
[*]Medal slots and medals have different tooltips now in the profile unlock screen.
[*]Fixed an issue where going back in the medal/portrait selection screen would hide the two progression counters in the profile menu as well as the global chat.
[*]Returning from a specific naut in the armory to the armory browser will now open to the page where this last viewed Naut can be accessed.
[*]The overview toggle button in the armory will remember the last chosen setting after you close the game.
[*]Moved the portraits in the watch menu so they don’t drop off the right side of the screen.
[*]Skins with special voices will now play during the end of match screen, instead of the normal voice line.
[*]Changed the layout of the profile stats menu: Game mode selection has been moved to the bottom of the screen, while character name, and played/wins stats have been moved up.
[*]Fixed a situation in which global chat would disappear.
[*]Improved controller support in the menus.[/list]
[b]Soundtrack DLC[/b][list]
[*]Added an extended version of the music that plays during the droppod sequence at the start of a match.[/list]
[b]Replays[/b][list]
[*]Made some changes that hopefully fix the issue that replays of modded matches sometimes played on Ribbit instead of on the modded map (these changes should also fix this for already existing replays). Also added additional logging, so if you still have this issue then please [url=https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=13&t=2223]send us your log files[/url] so we can analyse this issue further.
[*]Fixed that character animations would often not play during the first few seconds after a character had spawned (only fixed for newly recorded replays).
[*]Fixed that damage numbers in replays would often show 1 too low, so for example 31 instead of 32 (only fixed for newly recorded replays).
[*]Fixed that Match of the day in the watch menu didn’t show the correct players for that match anymore.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Chucho Krokk[/b][list]
[*]Improved visual clarity on Chucho’s sticky bomb timers by increasing the contrast a little.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list]
[*]Made the sound for Spit healing Weedlings more subtle.
[*]Fixed that Gnaw would start with less parts when respawning after Bag of Seeds was bought.
[*]Added an ammo bar for the current amount of parts and weedlings.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that LUX Charge used sounds from Lonestar’s Bull.
[*]Added a clearer visual indication for Lux’s ‘Danger pins’ upgrade.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ksenia_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ksenia[/b][list]
[*]Added Vanish skill voice-lines to Ksenia and Cosmic Captain Ksenia.
[*]Added an ammo bar for the current amount of scissors.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yoolip_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Yoolip[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that the counter for Quark Microscope was missing from the HUD.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list]
[*]Improved Timerift collision handling, reducing the chance that it slides off a glass platform.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list]
[*]Added a small arrow pointing to an active Beacon.[/list]
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b][list]
[*]Added an ammo bar for the current amount of shotgun shells.[/list]
[b]Modding[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that AI editor could not expand ExecuteBehaviourTree blocks with modded AIs in them.
[*]Teleporters can now be limited to only work creeps/humans/bots or to specific classes. Teleporters now also allow more control when limiting them by team.
[*]AffectAreas can now be limited to only work on creeps/humans/bots and to specific classes.
[*]Added option [i]dontOffsetWithParallax[/i] to Particles objects.[/list]

[*]Fixed a rare crash that happened during the victory animation.
[*]Fixed a crash when launching the game while Steam is not running.
[*]Fixed a rare crash when uploading a replay fails.
[*]Fixed that a small number was sometimes shown over the player character, in the middle of the screen during gameplay.

[*]Added an extended version of the music that plays during the droppod sequence at the start of a match.[/list]

notes.title: Beta keys, Founder Rewards, and community news!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png[/img]
We're getting closer to the release of Awesomenauts 4.0 and there is a lot of news to cover prior to the Free-to-Play release!

We’ll give you a full rundown of this week's news covered on the Streamisho  below. If you prefer to watch the Streamisho on Youtube, you can do so here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ved3xjMZ0jQ&
[h1]Beta keys[/h1]
With the free-to-play launch of Awesomenauts 4.0 getting closer, we are giving out Beta keys in several ways. For now you can get Beta keys by signing up [url=https://www.awesomenauts.com/sign-up-for-beta-access/]on our website[/url], or on [url=http://mmo-play.com/rpg-games/awesomenauts/giveaways/awesomenauts-closed-beta-giveaway#.WRJN1mU3KBk.twitter]the MMO-Play website[/url]. Be sure to check out our social media channels for more Beta acces information!

[h1]New Founder Reward[/h1]
We announced last week that we wanted to add another Founder Reward for the people that supported us for such a long time. Today we revealed that all founders will get the Mark II ‘Falling Closet’ droppod for free when it launches in 4.0.3 early next week! This droppod will also be available for purchase by non-founders.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/fa3475130f7114413580fdf7d7cc4f93db2cdadd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Reddit AMA[/h1]
We will be doing a Reddit AMA on the 18th of May. AMA stands for Ask Me Anything, and a delegation of Ronimo Games will be online on Reddit to answer all your questions related to game development, Awesomenauts, or what color socks we are wearing! Details to be announced soon.

[h1]Community news[/h1]

[h1]Guide contest[/h1]
The guide contest started on the 2nd of May and anyone who owns a copy of Awesomenauts is eligible to participate in the contest. The contest runs until Wednesday, May 31st, 17:00 EU / 16:00 UK / 11 AM Eastern / 8 AM PT. Check out the announcement for extended information on the Guide Contest:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1299695964251491198
[h1]Awesomenauts Rumble[/h1]
The Awesomenauts Rumble team has opened sign-ups for the Gathers tournament in May. The Rumble team encourages everyone, experienced or new, to join the casual 3v3 tournament. More information on the Gathers tournament here: https://sites.google.com/awesomenautsrumble.com/home/gathers?authuser=0 

Be sure to check out the Awesomenauts Rumble: Scrim Show for competitive scrims and updates about their tournaments. Find them on: twitch.tv/awesomenautsrumble on the 11th of May, 18:00 CET, 17:00 UK, 12AM EDT, 9AM PT.

[h1]Workshop highlight[/h1]
If you like custom maps, check out Ribbit V by Gnarlyman. It's a huge map with a lot of hide-areas, 12 turrets, and hidden shops!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=921632195 
[h1]SlowWolf[/h1]
Congratulations to Slow Wolf on hitting 200 episodes in your Let's Play series! Thanks for making so many Awesomenauts videos on Youtube. We've seen a lot of new people create videos on Youtube as well recently, and we love that. Thanks for helping us spread the word!

Check out SlowWolf’s channel for helpful Awesomenauts videos: https://www.youtube.com/slowwolfgaming

notes.title: A note on Offline Play
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png[/img]
Hey everyone! We'd like to make a quick announcement regarding some of the discussions on offline play that we've seen in the community!

There seems to be a lot of misunderstanding regarding the ability to play offline in Awesomenauts. Some people think we've removed botmatches and splitscreen with the latest update, but that's not the case: [b]you can still play with and against bots in Update 4.0, and you can still play local splitscreen multiplayer[/b]. The only change here is that you need to have an internet connection to start the game, since your unlocks are now stored in the cloud.

In addition, some players have told us they want to be able to play when they don't have access to the internet at all. To make sure those players won't lose any features that they previously had access to, we've decided to permanently leave an offline-only version of Update 3.5 available on Steam. And the nice thing is: it's available already!

You can get the offline version like this:
[list][*]Right click Awesomenauts in your Steam library and go to Properties.
[*]Go to the DLC tab.
[*]Enable the DLC called "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load PC" (or Mac or Linux depending on your platform).
[*]When you now start the game you can play offline by selecting "Play Awesomenauts Beta".[/list]
We'll replace this with a permanent solution in a few weeks, since future betas will overwrite your ability to access this particular version of the game. Once the way to access the offline version of Awesomenauts changes and we have the permanent solution ready for you, we'll let you know!

For now, enjoy!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png[/img]We just released the first hotfix to Awesomenauts 4.0, including fixes for several gameplay issues and plenty of other improvements.

For more info on all the new features included in the 4.0 launch that released earlier this week, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1299695964228789174]please check out the announcement we made on that[/url].

[h1][b]Update 4.0.1[/b][/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed that turret health had been decreased by 20%. Turrets now have their correct health values back.
[*]Fixed that you couldn’t chat during the victory/defeat screen.
[*]Fixed that sometimes the Creeper Clunk Skin was incorrectly locked.
[*]Reworked Slowwolf Announcer to hopefully fix that he sometimes didn’t unlock. If you had this problem then please let us know if it is fixed now.
[*]Fixed that queue times for co-op vs bots were way too long. It’s now the intended 2 minutes. Note that co-op vs bots might have few players until we actually go free to play on May 24th.
[*]Fixed that co-op vs bots matches used only one map (Ribbit IV).
[*]Visually improved the droppod backgrounds for players with a Low background quality setting.
[*]Fixed team colour and the neutral colour for the custom game bomb when using the ‘explode on death’ setting.
[*]Improved visual clarity of the profile level 50 medal.
[*]In the player status dock, the health of the blue team is now blue when colourblind mode is on.
[*]When the game has trouble receiving end of game progress information, the game now waits for a maximum of 2 minutes after the game to retrieve that info and show you your rewards.[/list]

[b]Progression[/b][list]
[*]The XP needed to level your account from level 0 to 1 has been decreased from 480 to 315
[*]The XP needed to level your account from level 1 to 2 has been increased from 495 to 550
[*]The XP needed to level a character from level 0 to 1 has been decreased from 400 to 315[/list]

[b]Menus[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that featured matches didn’t show in the Watch menu.
[*]Fixed some cases where global chat sometimes randomly disappeared (seems like it still happens sometimes, let us know if this happens to you and in what situation).
[*]Recruitment code now correctly displays on Linux.
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing back on controller in character select while matchmaking would cause the leave game popup to not be controllable for 5s.
[*]Safe to leave message moved up so it isn’t blocked anymore by the exit menu button in the ingame menu.
[*]When a naut is already unlocked it will not show the discount label anymore.
[*]When you have selected a character that has less than a minute of total play time, the profile stats screen now shows “0” instead of displaying incorrect values for the “per minute” stat in each stat category.
[*]Fixed that in some occasions the progression bar in the armory kept counting up and resetting.
[*]Fixed that the tutorial character GG7 kept talking during popups that should silence him.
[*]Fixed a typo in the prestige medal descriptions.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Chucho Krokk[/b][list]
[*]Teamcolour is now being displayed properly on Chucho's sticky bomb.
[*]The tiny sticky bomb, from the Trick-Up-Your-Sleeve upgrade, should now play it's entire animation instead of resetting after starting.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that fertilizing Weedlings would play the heal sound rapidly.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that the Nano Repair Bots lifesteal would proc multiple times for multiple hit targets.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list]
[*]Activating Black Hole Sun will now always use the skin’s appropriate voice.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png[/img]We just released the first hotfix to Awesomenauts 4.0, including fixes for several gameplay issues and plenty of other improvements.

For more info on all the new features included in the 4.0 launch that released earlier this week, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1299695964228789174]please check out the announcement we made on that[/url].

[h1][b]Update 4.0.1[/b][/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed that turret health had been decreased by 20%. Turrets now have their correct health values back.
[*]Fixed that you couldn’t chat during the victory/defeat screen.
[*]Fixed that sometimes the Creeper Clunk Skin was incorrectly locked.
[*]Reworked Slowwolf Announcer to hopefully fix that he sometimes didn’t unlock. If you had this problem then please let us know if it is fixed now.
[*]Fixed that queue times for co-op vs bots were way too long. It’s now the intended 2 minutes. Note that co-op vs bots might have few players until we actually go free to play on May 24th.
[*]Fixed that co-op vs bots matches used only one map (Ribbit IV).
[*]Visually improved the droppod backgrounds for players with a Low background quality setting.
[*]Fixed team colour and the neutral colour for the custom game bomb when using the ‘explode on death’ setting.
[*]Improved visual clarity of the profile level 50 medal.
[*]In the player status dock, the health of the blue team is now blue when colourblind mode is on.
[*]When the game has trouble receiving end of game progress information, the game now waits for a maximum of 2 minutes after the game to retrieve that info and show you your rewards.[/list]

[b]Progression[/b][list]
[*]The XP needed to level your account from level 0 to 1 has been decreased from 480 to 315
[*]The XP needed to level your account from level 1 to 2 has been increased from 495 to 550
[*]The XP needed to level a character from level 0 to 1 has been decreased from 400 to 315[/list]

[b]Menus[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that featured matches didn’t show in the Watch menu.
[*]Fixed some cases where global chat sometimes randomly disappeared (seems like it still happens sometimes, let us know if this happens to you and in what situation).
[*]Recruitment code now correctly displays on Linux.
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing back on controller in character select while matchmaking would cause the leave game popup to not be controllable for 5s.
[*]Safe to leave message moved up so it isn’t blocked anymore by the exit menu button in the ingame menu.
[*]When a naut is already unlocked it will not show the discount label anymore.

[*]Fixed that in some occasions the progression bar in the armory kept counting up and resetting.
[*]Fixed that the tutorial character GG7 kept talking during popups that should silence him.
[*]Fixed a typo in the prestige medal descriptions.[/list]

[b]Chucho Krokk[/b][list]

[*]The tiny sticky bomb, from the Trick-Up-Your-Sleeve upgrade, should now play it's entire animation instead of resetting after starting.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that fertilizing Weedlings would play the heal sound rapidly.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that the Nano Repair Bots lifesteal would proc multiple times for multiple hit targets.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list]
[*]Activating Black Hole Sun will now always use the skin’s appropriate voice.[/list]
